#heatmap
```{r}
phy1=subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha,covid_casos_control_analysis=="Yes")
#select only positive
phy1_pos=subset_samples(phy1,COVID_consensus=="Positive")

#extract metadata from phy1_pos
met1_pos=data.frame(sample_data(phy1_pos))


###############
# Crear un vector con los síntomas de mucosas
mucosa_symptoms <- c(
  "Throat_pain",
  "Nasal_Congestion",
  "Loss_of_smell",
  "Loss_of_taste",
 # "Conjuntivitis",
  "Excessive_tearing",
  "Sputum_Phlegm",
 "Dry_Cough",
 "Difficulty_Breathing"
)


# Crear una nueva tabla con id y las variables seleccionadas
symptom_data <- met1_pos[, c("Patient_ID", mucosa_symptoms)]
symptom_data

# Contar el número de síntomas presentes por individuo
symptom_data$Symptom_Count <- rowSums(symptom_data[, mucosa_symptoms] == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE)

# Ordenar los IDs por el número de síntomas de mayor a menor
symptom_data <- symptom_data[order(-symptom_data$Symptom_Count), ]

# Extraer solo la matriz de síntomas
symptom_matrix <- as.matrix(symptom_data[, mucosa_symptoms])

# Reemplazar valores por 1 (Yes), 0 (No) y NA
symptom_matrix <- ifelse(symptom_matrix == "Yes", 1, ifelse(symptom_matrix == "No", 0, NA))

# Asignar nombres de filas a la matriz de síntomas
rownames(symptom_matrix) <- symptom_data$Patient_ID

#pdf("results/plots/heatmap_mucosa_symptoms.pdf", width = 5, height = 7)
heatmap.2(symptom_matrix, 
          Rowv = T, 
          Colv = FALSE,
          dendrogram = "row",
          sepcolor = "black",
          colsep = 1:ncol(symptom_matrix),
          rowsep = 1:nrow(symptom_matrix),
          col = c("lightblue", "orange"),
          na.color = "grey1", 
          trace = "none",
          margins = c(10, 10),
          key = TRUE)
#dev.off()



```


# Alpha linear model
To run any_mucosa_symptom, you need to uncomment the filtering step
```{r}
# Cambia el valor de esta variable para ajustar el análisis
main_variable <- "COVID_consensus"
#main_variable <- "any_mucosa_symptom"

# Selección de variables y elimina NA de las variables seleccionadas
var <- met %>% dplyr::select(c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv", "BMI","Age", main_variable, "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"))

# Omitir NAs
var1 <- na.omit(var)

# Definir fórmulas para los modelos
define_formula <- function(outcome) {
  formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ Age + BMI + antibiotics_last_2months +", main_variable, " + Sex"))
}

form_obs <- define_formula("obs_rar_asv")
form_sha <- define_formula("shannon_rar_asv")

# Ejecutar los modelos
mod_obs <- lm(form_obs, data = var1)
mod_sha <- lm(form_sha, data = var1)

# Verificar la normalidad de los residuos
shapiro_obs <- shapiro.test(mod_obs$residuals)
shapiro_sha <- shapiro.test(mod_sha$residuals)

# Elegir el mejor modelo ajustado
mod_best_obs0 <- step(mod_obs)
mod_best_sha0 <- step(mod_sha)

# Nombrar el mejor modelo ajustado
best_obs0 <- summary(mod_best_obs0)
best_sha0 <- summary(mod_best_sha0)

# Obtener la fecha actual en formato YYYYMMDD
current_date <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d")

# Definir la ruta para guardar los archivos usando la fecha actual y la variable principal
save_path <- paste0("results/alpha/", current_date, "_", main_variable, "/")

# Crear el directorio si no existe
if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)  # Crear directorio incluyendo subdirectorios si no existen
}

# Capturar y guardar resúmenes de los modelos
writeLines(capture.output(best_obs0), con = paste0(save_path, "best_obs0_summary.txt"))
writeLines(capture.output(best_sha0), con = paste0(save_path, "best_sha0_summary.txt"))


# Repetir el análisis filtrando por antibióticos
phy2 <- subset_samples(phy1, antibiotics_last_2months == "No")
met2 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy2))
var2 <- met2 %>% dplyr::select(c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv", "BMI","Age", main_variable, "Sex"))
var2 <- na.omit(var2)


# Definir fórmulas para los modelos
define_formula1 <- function(outcome) {
#  formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ Age + BMI +", main_variable, " + Sex"))
    formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ Age  + antibiotics_last_2months +", main_variable, " + Sex"))

}

form_obs <- define_formula1("obs_rar_asv")
form_sha <- define_formula1("shannon_rar_asv")
# Ejecutar modelos para los datos filtrados
mod_obs2 <- lm(form_obs, data = var2)
mod_sha2 <- lm(form_sha, data = var2)

# Verificar normalidad de residuos
shapiro_obs2 <- shapiro.test(mod_obs2$residuals)
shapiro_sha2 <- shapiro.test(mod_sha2$residuals)

# Elegir el mejor modelo ajustado
mod_best_obs2 <- step(mod_obs2)
mod_best_sha2 <- step(mod_sha2)

# Nombrar el mejor modelo ajustado
best_obs2 <- summary(mod_best_obs2)
best_sha2 <- summary(mod_best_sha2)

# Guardar resultados para datos filtrados
writeLines(capture.output(best_obs2), con = paste0(save_path, "wo_ab_best_obs_summary.txt"))
writeLines(capture.output(best_sha2), con = paste0(save_path, "wo_ab_best_sha_summary.txt"))



```

```{r}

# Define la variable principal de análisis
# Cambia el valor de esta variable para ajustar el análisis
main_variable <- "any_mucosa_symptom"
phy3 <- subset_samples(phy1, COVID_consensus == "Positive")
met3 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy3))

# Selección de variables
var <- met3 %>% dplyr::select(c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv", "antibiotics_last_2months","BMI","Age", main_variable, "Sex"))

# Omitir NAs
var1 <- na.omit(var)

# Definir fórmulas para los modelos
define_formula <- function(outcome) {
  formula(paste0(outcome, " ~ Age + BMI + antibiotics_last_2months+", main_variable, " + Sex"))
}

form_obs <- define_formula("obs_rar_asv")
form_sha <- define_formula("shannon_rar_asv")

# Ejecutar los modelos
mod_obs <- lm(form_obs, data = var1)
mod_sha <- lm(form_sha, data = var1)

# Verificar la normalidad de los residuos
shapiro_obs <- shapiro.test(mod_obs$residuals)
shapiro_sha <- shapiro.test(mod_sha$residuals)

# Elegir el mejor modelo ajustado
mod_best_obs0 <- step(mod_obs)
mod_best_sha0 <- step(mod_sha)

# Nombrar el mejor modelo ajustado
best_obs0 <- summary(mod_best_obs0)
best_sha0 <- summary(mod_best_sha0)

# Obtener la fecha actual en formato YYYYMMDD

# Definir la ruta para guardar los archivos usando la fecha actual y la variable principal
save_path <- paste0("results/alpha/", current_date, "_", main_variable, "/")

# Crear el directorio si no existe
if (!dir.exists(save_path)) {
  dir.create(save_path, recursive = TRUE)  # Crear directorio incluyendo subdirectorios si no existen
}

# Capturar y guardar resúmenes de los modelos
writeLines(capture.output(best_obs0), con = paste0(save_path, "best_obs0_summary.txt"))
writeLines(capture.output(best_sha0), con = paste0(save_path, "best_sha0_summary.txt"))


# Repetir el análisis filtrando por antibióticos

phy3=subset_samples(phy2,COVID_consensus=="Positive")

met2 <- data.frame(sample_data(phy3))
var3 <- met2 %>% dplyr::select(c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv", "BMI","Age", main_variable, "Sex"))

var3 <- na.omit(var3)

mod_sha2 <- lm(form_sha, data = var3)

# Verificar normalidad de residuos
```

# Beta Aitchison (COVID_consensus wo antibiotics) RAW, plot y beta disper 
Se probó tambien con Jaccard, Bray, con y son antibiotico y nada da significativo, solo Aitchison da marginalmente significativo

```{r}
load("/Users/danielavargasrobles/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-danielavargasrobles@gmail.com/My Drive/Filipa_Daniela_2021 -present/Proyectos/ORAL_COVID/phy_objects/PHYraw.RData")
phy=PHYraw

# Filtrar solo los casos de COVID
phy=subset_samples(phy, covid_casos_control_analysis=="Yes")

# Análisis con muestras sin antibióticos en los últimos 2 meses
phy_no_abx <- subset_samples(phy, antibiotics_last_2months=="No")
phy_no_abx <- subset_samples(phy_no_abx, id!="COV-T1-725")
met_no_abx <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_no_abx))
met1_no_abx <- met_no_abx %>%
    dplyr::select(COVID_consensus, Age, BMI, Sex, id) %>%
    drop_na()
OTU_table_no_abx <- transform_sample_counts(phy_no_abx, function(x) x + 1)
OTU_matrix_no_abx <- otu_table(OTU_table_no_abx)
clr_transformed_no_abx <- clr(as.matrix(OTU_matrix_no_abx))
phy_clr_no_abx <- phyloseq(otu_table(clr_transformed_no_abx, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(phy_no_abx), sample_data(met1_no_abx))
aitch_dist_no_abx <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr_no_abx, method = "euclidean")
form_mod3 <- formula(paste0("aitch_dist_no_abx ~  COVID_consensus + Age + Sex "))
set.seed(124)
mod_adonis3_no_abx <- adonis2(form_mod3, data = met1_no_abx, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
fecha_hoy <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir.create(file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
output_csv_no_abx <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, paste0("no_abx_adonis_results_aich_4var_raw.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(mod_adonis3_no_abx), file = output_csv_no_abx, row.names = TRUE)
print(mod_adonis3_no_abx)
pval_consensus_no_abx = mod_adonis3_no_abx$`Pr(>F)`[1]
disp_beta_no_abx <- betadisper(aitch_dist_no_abx, group = met1_no_abx$COVID_consensus)
set.seed(124)
permut_test_no_abx <- permutest(disp_beta_no_abx, pairwise = FALSE, permutations = 999)
output_txt_no_abx <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, "permutest_beta_dispersion_results_no_abx.txt")
writeLines(capture.output(print(permut_test_no_abx)), con = output_txt_no_abx)
print(permut_test_no_abx)
mds_no_abx <- metaMDS(aitch_dist_no_abx, trymax = 25)
mds_scores_no_abx <- as.data.frame(scores(mds_no_abx))
mds_scores_no_abx$sample_id <- row.names(mds_scores_no_abx)
met1_no_abx$sample_id <- row.names(met1_no_abx)
mds_data_no_abx <- merge(mds_scores_no_abx, met1_no_abx, by = "sample_id")
palette <- c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")
p_no_abx <- ggplot(mds_data_no_abx, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = COVID_consensus)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = COVID_consensus), alpha = 0.2, level = 0.95, geom = "polygon") +
  theme_prism(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "MDS Ordination by COVID consensus (No Antibiotics) . aitch_dist dist",
       x = "NMDS1",
       y = "NMDS2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("p = ", format(pval_consensus_no_abx, digits = 3)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5)
ggsave(file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, "MDS_aitch_dist_by_covid_conse_no_abx_4var_raw.pdf"), plot = p_no_abx, width = 8, height = 6)
p_no_abx

# Análisis con todas las muestras
phy_all <- subset_samples(phy, id!="COV-T1-725")
met_all <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_all))
met1_all <- met_all %>%
    dplyr::select(COVID_consensus, Age, BMI, Sex,antibiotics_last_2months, id) %>%
    drop_na()
OTU_table_all <- transform_sample_counts(phy_all, function(x) x + 1)
OTU_matrix_all <- otu_table(OTU_table_all)
clr_transformed_all <- clr(as.matrix(OTU_matrix_all))
phy_clr_all <- phyloseq(otu_table(clr_transformed_all, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(phy_all), sample_data(met1_all))
aitch_dist_all <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr_all, method = "euclidean")
form_mod3 <- formula(paste0("aitch_dist_all ~  COVID_consensus + Age + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months"))
set.seed(711)
mod_adonis3_all <- adonis2(form_mod3, data = met1_all, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
output_csv_all <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, paste0("all_adonis_results_aich_4var_raw.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(mod_adonis3_all), file = output_csv_all, row.names = TRUE)
print(mod_adonis3_all)
pval_consensus_all = mod_adonis3_all$`Pr(>F)`[1]
disp_beta_all <- betadisper(aitch_dist_all, group = met1_all$COVID_consensus)
set.seed(711)
permut_test_all <- permutest(disp_beta_all, pairwise = FALSE, permutations = 999)
output_txt_all <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, "permutest_beta_dispersion_results_all.txt")
writeLines(capture.output(print(permut_test_all)), con = output_txt_all)
print(permut_test_all)
mds_all <- metaMDS(aitch_dist_all, trymax = 25)
mds_scores_all <- as.data.frame(scores(mds_all))
mds_scores_all$sample_id <- row.names(mds_scores_all)
met1_all$sample_id <- row.names(met1_all)
mds_data_all <- merge(mds_scores_all, met1_all, by = "sample_id")
p_all <- ggplot(mds_data_all, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = COVID_consensus)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = COVID_consensus), alpha = 0.2, level = 0.95, geom = "polygon") +
  theme_prism(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "MDS Ordination by COVID consensus (All Samples) . aitch_dist dist",
       x = "NMDS1",
       y = "NMDS2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
```

# Beta Aitchison (any_mucosa_symthpms) RAW, plot y beta disper

```{r}
load("phy_objects/PHYraw.RData")
phy=PHYraw

# Filtrar solo los casos de COVID positivos
phy=subset_samples(phy, covid_casos_control_analysis=="Yes" & COVID_consensus=="Positive")

# Análisis con muestras sin antibióticos en los últimos 2 meses
phy_no_abx <- subset_samples(phy, antibiotics_last_2months=="No")
phy_no_abx <- subset_samples(phy_no_abx, id!="COV-T1-725")
met_no_abx <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_no_abx))
met1_no_abx <- met_no_abx %>%
    dplyr::select(any_mucosa_symptom, Age, BMI, Sex, id) %>%
    drop_na()
OTU_table_no_abx <- transform_sample_counts(phy_no_abx, function(x) x + 1)
OTU_matrix_no_abx <- otu_table(OTU_table_no_abx)
clr_transformed_no_abx <- clr(as.matrix(OTU_matrix_no_abx))
phy_clr_no_abx <- phyloseq(otu_table(clr_transformed_no_abx, taxa_are_rows=TRUE), tax_table(phy_no_abx), sample_data(met1_no_abx))
aitch_dist_no_abx <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr_no_abx, method = "euclidean")
form_mod3 <- formula(paste0("aitch_dist_no_abx ~  any_mucosa_symptom + Age + Sex "))
set.seed(711)
mod_adonis3_no_abx <- adonis2(form_mod3, data = met1_no_abx, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
fecha_hoy <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
dir.create(file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
output_csv_no_abx <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, paste0("no_abx_adonis_results_any_mucosa_4var_raw.csv"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(mod_adonis3_no_abx), file = output_csv_no_abx, row.names = TRUE)
print(mod_adonis3_no_abx)
pval_symptom_no_abx = mod_adonis3_no_abx$`Pr(>F)`[1]
disp_beta_no_abx <- betadisper(aitch_dist_no_abx, group = met1_no_abx$any_mucosa_symptom)
set.seed(711)
permut_test_no_abx <- permutest(disp_beta_no_abx, pairwise = FALSE, permutations = 999)
output_txt_no_abx <- file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, "dispersion_any_mucosa_wo_ab.txt")
writeLines(capture.output(print(permut_test_no_abx)), con = output_txt_no_abx)
print(permut_test_no_abx)
mds_no_abx <- metaMDS(aitch_dist_no_abx, trymax = 25)
mds_scores_no_abx <- as.data.frame(scores(mds_no_abx))
mds_scores_no_abx$sample_id <- row.names(mds_scores_no_abx)
met1_no_abx$sample_id <- row.names(met1_no_abx)
mds_data_no_abx <- merge(mds_scores_no_abx, met1_no_abx, by = "sample_id")
palette <- c("Yes" = "#ff6347", "No" = "#5a9bd4")
p_no_abx <- ggplot(mds_data_no_abx, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = any_mucosa_symptom)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = any_mucosa_symptom), alpha = 0.2, level = 0.95, geom = "polygon") +
  theme_prism(base_size = 16) +
  labs(title = "MDS Ordination by Any Mucosa Symptom (No Antibiotics) . aitch_dist dist",
       x = "NMDS1",
       y = "NMDS2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("p = ", format(pval_symptom_no_abx, digits = 3)), 
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 2, size = 5)
ggsave(file.path("results/beta", fecha_hoy, "MDS_aitch_dist_by_any_mucosa_symptom_wo_ab.pdf"), plot = p_no_abx, width = 8, height = 6)
p_no_abx
```

#Masslin all levels study_group
Aqui estamos filtrando siempre los ASV antes dehacer la aglomeracion a cualquier nivel. Es lo más recomendado
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(Maaslin2)
library(ggplot2)

# Cargar objeto phyloseq y seleccionar muestras
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")

# Define taxonomic levels to analyze
tax_levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family", "Class", "Order", "Phylum")

# Parámetros de filtrado
perc_samples <- 0.20
abundance_threshold <- 15
today <- Sys.Date()
bs <- "all_samples"

# ------- FILTRADO A NIVEL ASV -------
cat("Filtrando ASV\n")
phy_prop <- transform_sample_counts(phy, function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)
phy_filt_asv <- filter_taxa(phy_prop, function(x) sum(x > 0) > (perc_samples * length(x)), TRUE)
phy_filt_asv <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_filt_asv) > abundance_threshold, phy_filt_asv)
taxa_names(phy_filt_asv) <- make.unique(taxa_names(phy_filt_asv))

# Crear nombres nuevos con el nombre de la especie (si existe) más el ID del ASV
tax_df_asv <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_filt_asv))
species_names <- ifelse(
  !is.na(tax_df_asv$Species) & tax_df_asv$Species != "",
  paste0(tax_df_asv$Species, "|", rownames(tax_df_asv)),
  rownames(tax_df_asv)
)

# Aplicar los nuevos nombres a todas las tablas del objeto phyloseq
taxa_names(phy_filt_asv) <- species_names
rownames(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)) <- species_names
# Extract OTU table y metadata
otu_table_asv <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)))
sample_metadata <- as(sample_data(phy_filt_asv), "data.frame")

# Output dir para ASV
output_dir <- paste0("results/maaslin2/", today, "/", bs, "/no_BMI_ASV_20prev_sig0_25_ab15per_unique")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Maaslin2 a nivel ASV
fit_asv <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = otu_table_asv, 
  input_metadata = sample_metadata, 
  output = output_dir,
  fixed_effects = c("COVID_consensus", "Age", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
  random_effects = NULL,
  normalization = "TSS",
  transform = "LOG",
  analysis_method = "LM",
  correction = "BH",
  standardize = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.25,
  min_abundance = 0,
  min_prevalence = 0
)

# ------- FILTRADO Y MAASLIN2 A NIVEL TAXONÓMICO -------
# Asegurar nombres únicos para especies "Unclassified"
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_df)) {
  tax_df$Species <- ifelse(
    grepl("_s__Unclassified$", tax_df$Species),
    paste0(tax_df$Species, "_", taxa_names(phy)),
    tax_df$Species
  )
  tax_table(phy) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_df))
} else {
  stop("Species column not found in tax_table!")
}

# Iterar por niveles taxonómicos
for (tax_level in tax_levels) {
  cat("Procesando", tax_level, "\n")
  
  # Aglomerar después del filtrado
  phy_level <- tax_glom(phy_filt_asv, taxrank = tax_level)
  
  # Asegurar nombres únicos para Maaslin2
  taxa_names(phy_level) <- make.unique(tax_table(phy_level)[, tax_level])
  
  # Extraer datos
  otu_table_lvl <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_level)))
  sample_metadata <- as(sample_data(phy_level), "data.frame")
  
  # Output dir
  output_dir <- paste0("results/maaslin2/", today, "/", bs, "/", tax_level, "_no_BMI_20prev_sig0_25_ab15per_unique")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Maaslin2 para nivel taxonómico
  fit_data <- Maaslin2(
    input_data = otu_table_lvl, 
    input_metadata = sample_metadata, 
    output = output_dir,
    fixed_effects = c("COVID_consensus", "Age", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
    random_effects = NULL,
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction = "BH",
    standardize = TRUE,
    max_significance = 0.25,
    min_abundance = 0,
    min_prevalence = 0
  )
}
```

#relative ab boxplot genus
```{r}
# Cargar objeto phyloseq y seleccionar muestras
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
#extract taxa table
tax_table <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))

#glom genis
physeq_subset <- tax_glom(phy, taxrank = "Genus")
target_Genus <- c('g__Leptotrichia',
                    'g__Lachnospiraceae_[G-2]')


# Remove samples with zero reads (if any) to avoid issues

# 2. Agglomerate taxa at the Genus level
# Note: The taxonomic rank might be named "Genus" - check and use correct rank

# 3. Transform counts to relative abundances per sample and then log transform
# First, transform to relative abundances
tax_rel_abund <- transform_sample_counts(physeq_subset, function(x) x / sum(x))

# Then, add a pseudocount (e.g., 1e-6) before log transform to avoid log(0)
#log_physeq <- transform_sample_counts(tax_rel_abund, function(x) log10(x + 1e-4))
log_physeq<-tax_rel_abund
# 4. Create data frame for plotting
# Melt the phyloseq object to get a long-format data frame
melted_df <- psmelt(log_physeq)

# Filter for target Genus using the Genus column in taxonomy table
# Note: sometimes the Genus names might be in the 'Genus' column, but here they appear to be labels as provided.
melted_df_target <- melted_df[melted_df$Genus %in% target_Genus, ]

# Check variable name: severe should be in sample_data? Ensure it's a factor with levels: PE and Control
melted_df_target$COVID_consensus <- factor(melted_df_target$COVID_consensus, levels = c('Positive', 'Negative'))

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Crear carpeta con la fecha actual
fecha_actual <- Sys.Date()
output_dir <- paste0("results/rel_abund_boxplots/", fecha_actual, "/COVID_consensus/")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Paleta de colores
palette <- c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")

# Obtener todas las eGenus únicas
genus <- unique(melted_df_target$Genus)

for (esp in genus) {
  df_plot <- filter(melted_df_target, Genus == esp)

  # Calcular tamaños de muestra por grupo de severidad
  counts <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(COVID_consensus) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

  # Crear etiquetas personalizadas para x
  labels_x <- setNames(
    paste0(counts$COVID_consensus, "\n(n=", counts$n, ")"),
    counts$COVID_consensus
  )

  # Plot
  p1 <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = COVID_consensus, y = Abundance, fill = COVID_consensus)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_x) +
    labs(
      x = 'Severity',
      y = 'Log10(Relative Abundance + 1e-4)',
      title = paste('Genus:', esp)
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = 'none',
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # Guardar el plot
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", gsub("[/: ]", "_", esp), ".pdf"),
    plot = p1,
    width = 2,
    height = 3.5
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Cargar objeto phyloseq y seleccionar muestras
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
#extract taxa table
```

```{r}
# Melt

  # Guardar

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", safe_name, ".pdf"),
    plot = p1,
    width = 2,

  )
}
```

```{r}
# Librerías
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
feature_table <- tribble(
  ~Analysis_Source, ~Taxonomic_Level, ~feature, ~metadata, ~value,
  "Without antibiotics", "Species", "g__Prevotella_nanceiensis", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "ASV", "5e35345dd1a79e31e4758572175cbdf5", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "ASV", "3fc86176b5b0c7e9e7fdd6afdd43bee8", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Prevotella_jejuni", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Leptotrichia_sp._oral_taxon_417", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Lachnospiraceae_[G-2]_sp._oral_taxon_096", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Prevotella_salivae", "COVID_consensus", "Positive",
  "All samples (any mucosa symptom)", "ASV", "497c4ce5804e46f74e506bc48cefd6c2", "any_mucosa_symptom", "Yes"
)

# === 1. Configuración base ===
phy <- PHYrar_alpha
phy <- subset_samples(phy, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")

# Leer tabla con features
feature_table <- read.csv("features_to_plot.csv", sep = "\t")  # reemplaza con el path correcto

# Crear carpeta para guardar los plots
fecha_actual <- Sys.Date()
output_dir_base <- paste0("results/rel_abund_boxplots/", fecha_actual, "/")
dir.create(output_dir_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Colores
palette <- c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4","No" = "#76B7B2", "Yes" = "#F28E2B")

# === 2. Loop por fila ===
for (i in 1:nrow(feature_table)) {
  row <- feature_table[i, ]

  tax_level <- row$Taxonomic_Level
  feature_id <- row$feature
  metadata_var <- row$metadata
  group_value <- row$value
  analysis_source <- row$Analysis_Source

  phy_subset <- phy

  # Filtrar si es "Without antibiotics"
  if (grepl("Without antibiotics", analysis_source)) {
    phy_subset <- subset_samples(phy_subset, antibiotics_last_2months == "No")
  }

  # Agregar pseudocuenta y transformar a abundancia relativa
  phy_subset <- transform_sample_counts(phy_subset, function(x) x / sum(x))

  # Agglomerar por taxonomic level si no es ASV
  if (tax_level != "ASV") {
    phy_subset <- tax_glom(phy_subset, taxrank = tax_level)
  }

  # Convertir a data frame largo
  melted_df <- psmelt(phy_subset)

  # Detectar columna para filtrar (ASV vs tax)
  if (tax_level == "ASV") {
    melted_df_target <- melted_df[melted_df$OTU == feature_id, ]
    label <- paste("ASV:", feature_id)
  } else {
    melted_df_target <- melted_df[melted_df[[tax_level]] == feature_id, ]
    label <- paste(tax_level, ":", feature_id)
  }

  # Convertir metadata en factor para que ggplot lo reconozca
  melted_df_target[[metadata_var]] <- factor(melted_df_target[[metadata_var]], 
                                             levels = unique(melted_df_target[[metadata_var]]))

  # Calcular tamaño de muestra por grupo
  counts <- melted_df_target %>%
    group_by_at(metadata_var) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  labels_x <- setNames(
    paste0(counts[[metadata_var]], "\n(n=", counts$n, ")"),
    counts[[metadata_var]]
  )

  # === 3. Plot ===
  p <- ggplot(melted_df_target, aes_string(x = metadata_var, y = "Abundance", fill = metadata_var)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_x) +
    labs(
      x = metadata_var,
      y = "Relative Abundance",
      title = label
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = 'none',
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # === 4. Guardar ===
  folder <- paste0(output_dir_base, metadata_var)
  dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(folder, "/", gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_]", "_", feature_id), ".pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 2,
    height = 3.5
  )
}
```

#boxplots for covid consensus 

```{r}
# --- Libraries ---
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# --- 0) Inputs ---
# Base phyloseq object
#   - phy_base: all COVID analysis cases (your previous filter)
#   - phy_pos:  subset of positives ONLY (for any_mucosa_symptom plots)
phy_base <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
phy_pos  <- subset_samples(phy_base, COVID_consensus == "Positive")

# Read table of features to plot (TSV expected)
feature_table <- read.delim("features_to_plot.csv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# --- 1) Output folders ---
fecha_actual <- Sys.Date()
output_dir_base <- file.path("results/rel_abund_boxplots", as.character(fecha_actual))
dir.create(output_dir_base, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- 2) Color palette (non-bright tones) ---
pal <- c(
  "Positive" = "#D55E5E",  # red-ish
  "Negative" = "#4E79A7",  # blue-ish
  "No"       = "#76B7B2",
  "Yes"      = "#F28E2B"
)

# --- 3) Helper: factor levels for common metadata vars ---
set_factor_levels <- function(df, var) {
  if (!var %in% names(df)) return(df)
  if (var == "COVID_consensus") {
    df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]], levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
  } else if (var == "any_mucosa_symptom") {
    df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]], levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  } else {
    # Keep encountered order
    df[[var]] <- factor(df[[var]], levels = unique(df[[var]]))
  }
  df
}

# --- 4) Main loop ---
for (i in seq_len(nrow(feature_table))) {
  rowi <- feature_table[i, ]

  tax_level      <- rowi$Taxonomic_Level
  feature_id     <- rowi$feature
  metadata_var   <- rowi$metadata
  group_value    <- rowi$value        # si lo usas para etiquetar
  analysis_src   <- rowi$Analysis_Source

  # --- 4.1 Choose phyloseq stream ---
  # any_mucosa_symptom must be filtered to positives only (phy_pos).
  # All other cases stay with phy_base.
  phy_subset <- if (identical(metadata_var, "any_mucosa_symptom")) phy_pos else phy_base

  # Optional: "Without antibiotics" filter
  if (is.character(analysis_src) && grepl("Without antibiotics", analysis_src, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    phy_subset <- subset_samples(phy_subset, antibiotics_last_2months == "No")
  }

  # Skip if empty after filtering
  if (nsamples(phy_subset) == 0L) next

  # --- 4.2 Relative abundance ---
  phy_subset <- transform_sample_counts(phy_subset, function(x) x / sum(x))

  # --- 4.3 Aggregate if needed ---
  if (!identical(tax_level, "ASV")) {
    phy_subset <- tax_glom(phy_subset, taxrank = tax_level, NArm = FALSE)
  }

  # --- 4.4 Melt to long format ---
  mdf <- psmelt(phy_subset)

  # --- 4.5 Select target feature (ASV vs taxon) ---
  if (identical(tax_level, "ASV")) {
    mdf_target <- mdf %>% filter(OTU == feature_id)
    plot_label <- paste("ASV:", feature_id)
  } else {
    if (!tax_level %in% names(mdf)) next
    mdf_target <- mdf %>% filter(.data[[tax_level]] == feature_id)
    plot_label <- paste0(tax_level, ": ", feature_id)
  }

  # Skip if empty
  if (nrow(mdf_target) == 0L) next

  # --- 4.6 Factor levels for the x variable ---
  mdf_target <- set_factor_levels(mdf_target, metadata_var)

  # --- 4.7 Group counts by unique samples (avoid overcounting by taxa) ---
  if (!"Sample" %in% names(mdf_target)) {
    # psmelt should create "Sample"; if not, try from rownames(sample_data)
    mdf_target$Sample <- mdf_target$sample
  }
  counts <- mdf_target %>%
    distinct(.data[[metadata_var]], Sample) %>%
    count(.data[[metadata_var]], name = "n")

  # Named vector for x-axis labels: "Level\n(n=##)"
  x_levels <- levels(mdf_target[[metadata_var]])
  x_labels <- setNames(
    object = paste0(x_levels, "\n(n=",
                    sapply(x_levels, function(lvl) {
                      val <- counts %>% filter(.data[[metadata_var]] == lvl) %>% pull(n)
                      if (length(val) == 0) 0 else val
                    }),
                    ")"),
    nm = x_levels
  )

  # --- 4.8 Plot ---
  p <- ggplot(mdf_target, aes_string(x = metadata_var, y = "Abundance", fill = metadata_var)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(
      x = metadata_var,
      y = "Relative Abundance",
      title = plot_label
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # --- 4.9 Save ---
  subfolder <- file.path(output_dir_base, metadata_var)
  dir.create(subfolder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  outfile <- file.path(
    subfolder,
    paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", feature_id), ".pdf")
  )
  ggsave(outfile, plot = p, width = 2.2, height = 3.6, units = "in")
}
```

```{r}
# Librerías
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(phyloseq)

# Tabla de taxones a graficar con pval y qval
feature_table <- tribble(
  ~Analysis_Source, ~Taxonomic_Level, ~feature, ~metadata, ~value, ~Taxon_Label, ~pval, ~qval,
  "Without antibiotics", "Species", "g__Prevotella_nanceiensis", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Prevotella nanceiensis (no abx)", 0.0159, 0.6407,
  "All samples", "ASV", "5e35345dd1a79e31e4758572175cbdf5", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Rothia mucilaginosa", 0.0327, 0.4717,
  "All samples", "ASV", "3fc86176b5b0c7e9e7fdd6afdd43bee8", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Prevotella nanceiensis (ASV)", 0.0316, 0.4717,
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Prevotella_jejuni", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Prevotella jejuni", 0.0155, 0.3596,
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Leptotrichia_sp._oral_taxon_417", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Leptotrichia oral taxon 417", 0.0294, 0.4024,
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Lachnospiraceae_[G-2]_sp._oral_taxon_096", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Lachno G-2 oral 096", 0.0322, 0.4061,
  "All samples", "Species", "g__Prevotella_salivae", "COVID_consensus", "Positive", "Prevotella salivae", 0.0402, 0.4285
)

# Subset principal
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
feature_table_covid <- filter(feature_table, metadata == "COVID_consensus")

# Loop para extraer datos de abundancia
lista_dfs <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(feature_table_covid)) {
  row <- feature_table_covid[i, ]
  phy_sub <- phy
  if (grepl("Without antibiotics", row$Analysis_Source)) {
    phy_sub <- subset_samples(phy_sub, antibiotics_last_2months == "No")
  }
  phy_sub <- transform_sample_counts(phy_sub, function(x) x / sum(x))
  if (row$Taxonomic_Level != "ASV") {
    phy_sub <- tax_glom(phy_sub, taxrank = row$Taxonomic_Level)
  }
  melted <- psmelt(phy_sub)
  df <- if (row$Taxonomic_Level == "ASV") {
    melted %>% filter(OTU == row$feature)
  } else {
    melted %>% filter(!!sym(row$Taxonomic_Level) == row$feature)
  }
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      log_abundance = Abundance,  # sin log
      Taxon_Label = row[["Taxon_Label"]]
    )
  lista_dfs[[i]] <- df
}

# Combinar todos
melted_df_total <- bind_rows(lista_dfs)
melted_df_total$Taxon_Label <- factor(melted_df_total$Taxon_Label,
                                      levels = unique(melted_df_total$Taxon_Label))

# Paleta de colores
palette <- c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")

# Calcular posición para el texto
means <- melted_df_total %>%
  group_by(Taxon_Label) %>%
  summarise(x_pos = max(log_abundance, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)

labels_df <- feature_table %>%
  select(Taxon_Label, pval, qval) %>%
  mutate(label_text = paste0("p=", signif(pval, 2), ", q=", signif(qval, 2))) %>%
  left_join(means, by = "Taxon_Label")

# Plot
p <- ggplot(melted_df_total, aes(x = log_abundance, y = Taxon_Label, fill = COVID_consensus)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "text", label = "★", color = "gray40",
               size = 5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2,
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7)) +
  geom_text(data = labels_df, aes(x = x_pos, y = Taxon_Label, label = label_text),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  scale_color_manual(values = palette) +
  labs(
    y = NULL,
    x = "Relative Abundance",
    title = "Relative Abundance of Selected Taxa by COVID Status"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Guardar
dir.create("results/rel_abund_boxplots", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(
  filename = paste0("results/rel_abund_boxplots/", Sys.Date(), "/combined_taxa_horizontal_boxplot.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 7,
  height = 4 + length(unique(melted_df_total$Taxon_Label)) * 0.4
)
```

#Masslin all levels any mucosa symptoms
Here we are always filtering the ASVs before performing the agglomeration at any taxonomic level. This is the recommended approach.
Here we remove the antibiotic-use variable because, after the prevalence filtering, only participants without antibiotic use remain. Since there is no variability, the script cannot run.
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)
library(Maaslin2)
library(ggplot2)

# Cargar objeto phyloseq y seleccionar muestras
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
phy <- subset_samples(phy, COVID_consensus == "Positive")


# Transform to relative abundance (%)
phy_prop <- transform_sample_counts(phy, function(x) x / sum(x) * 100)

# Prevalence filter: keep taxa present in > perc_samples of samples
OT <- otu_table(phy_prop)
margin <- if (taxa_are_rows(phy_prop)) 1 else 2
prev_counts <- apply(OT, margin, function(x) sum(x > 0))
keep_prev <- prev_counts > (perc_samples * nsamples(phy_prop))
phy_filt_asv <- prune_taxa(keep_prev, phy_prop)

# Abundance filter: keep taxa with summed % > threshold
keep_abund <- taxa_sums(phy_filt_asv) > abundance_threshold
phy_filt_asv <- prune_taxa(keep_abund, phy_filt_asv)

# Sanity check: deben seguir siendo 24 muestras
stopifnot(nsamples(phy_filt_asv) == 24)
cat("nsamples(phy_filt_asv):", nsamples(phy_filt_asv), "\n")
#extrat metdatda
meta <- as(sample_data(phy), "data.frame")
table(meta$antibiotics_last_2months, meta$any_mucosa_symptom)

# Define taxonomic levels to analyze
tax_levels <- c("Species", "Genus", "Family", "Class", "Order", "Phylum")

# Parámetros de filtrado
perc_samples <- 0.20
abundance_threshold <- 15
today <- Sys.Date()
bs <- "all_samples_any mucosa_sym"


# Crear nombres nuevos con el nombre de la especie (si existe) más el ID del ASV
tax_df_asv <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_filt_asv))
species_names <- ifelse(
  !is.na(tax_df_asv$Species) & tax_df_asv$Species != "",
  paste0(tax_df_asv$Species, "|", rownames(tax_df_asv)),
  rownames(tax_df_asv)
)

# Aplicar los nuevos nombres a todas las tablas del objeto phyloseq
taxa_names(phy_filt_asv) <- species_names
rownames(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)) <- species_names
# Extract OTU table y metadata
otu_table_asv <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)))
sample_metadata <- as(sample_data(phy_filt_asv), "data.frame")



# Output dir para ASV
output_dir <- paste0("results/maaslin2/", today, "/", bs, "/no_BMIASV_20prev_sig0_25_ab15per_unique")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# Maaslin2 a nivel ASV
fit_asv <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = otu_table_asv, 
  input_metadata = sample_metadata, 
  output = output_dir,
  fixed_effects = c("any_mucosa_symptom", "Age", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"), 
  random_effects = NULL,
  normalization = "TSS",
  transform = "LOG",
  analysis_method = "LM",
  correction = "BH",
  standardize = TRUE,
  max_significance = 0.25,
  min_abundance = 0,
  min_prevalence = 0
)

# ------- FILTRADO Y MAASLIN2 A NIVEL TAXONÓMICO -------
# Asegurar nombres únicos para especies "Unclassified"
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_df)) {
  tax_df$Species <- ifelse(
    grepl("_s__Unclassified$", tax_df$Species),
    paste0(tax_df$Species, "_", taxa_names(phy)),
    tax_df$Species
  )
  tax_table(phy) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tax_df))
} else {
  stop("Species column not found in tax_table!")
}

# Iterar por niveles taxonómicos
for (tax_level in tax_levels) {
  cat("Procesando", tax_level, "\n")
  
  # Aglomerar después del filtrado
  phy_level <- tax_glom(phy_filt_asv, taxrank = tax_level)
  
  # Asegurar nombres únicos para Maaslin2
  taxa_names(phy_level) <- make.unique(tax_table(phy_level)[, tax_level])
  
  # Extraer datos
  otu_table_lvl <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_level)))
  sample_metadata <- as(sample_data(phy_level), "data.frame")
  
  # Output dir
  output_dir <- paste0("results/maaslin2/", today, "/", bs, "/", tax_level, "_20prev_sig0_25_ab15per_unique")
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  
  # Maaslin2 para nivel taxonómico
  fit_data <- Maaslin2(
    input_data = otu_table_lvl, 
    input_metadata = sample_metadata, 
    output = output_dir,
    fixed_effects = c("any_mucosa_symptom", "Age", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
    random_effects = NULL,
    normalization = "TSS",
    transform = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction = "BH",
    standardize = TRUE,
    max_significance = 0.25,
    min_abundance = 0,
    min_prevalence = 0
  )
}
```

```{r}
# --- Libraries ---
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)  
library(stringr)

# --- 0) Base filtering ---
phy <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, covid_casos_control_analysis == "Yes")
phy <- subset_samples(phy, COVID_consensus == "Positive")  # required for any_mucosa_symptom plots
 phy
# --- 1) Target ASV and grouping ---
target_ASVs   <- c("497c4ce5804e46f74e506bc48cefd6c2")  # <-- your ASV of interest
grouping_var  <- "any_mucosa_symptom"

# --- 2) Relative abundance (no log by default) ---
phy_rel <- transform_sample_counts(phy, function(x) x / sum(x))

# --- 3) Melt to long DF ---
melted_df <- psmelt(phy_rel)

# --- 4) Filter to target ASV(s) ---
df_target <- dplyr::filter(melted_df, OTU %in% target_ASVs)

# Safety: drop NAs in grouping var
df_target <- dplyr::filter(df_target, !is.na(.data[[grouping_var]]))

# --- 5) Factor levels for x var (No, Yes) ---
if (grouping_var %in% names(df_target)) {
  df_target[[grouping_var]] <- factor(df_target[[grouping_var]], levels = c("No", "Yes"))
}

# --- 6) Output dir ---
fecha_actual <- Sys.Date()
output_dir <- file.path("results/rel_abund_boxplots", as.character(fecha_actual), grouping_var, "g__Veillonella_parvula")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- 7) Colors for Yes/No ---
palette_yesno <- c("No" = "#76B7B2", "Yes" = "#F28E2B")

# --- 8) Plot per ASV ---
for (asv in unique(df_target$OTU)) {
  df_plot <- dplyr::filter(df_target, OTU == asv)

  # Counts by unique samples to avoid taxon-inflated counts
  if (!"Sample" %in% names(df_plot) && "sample" %in% names(df_plot)) {
    df_plot$Sample <- df_plot$sample
  }
  counts <- df_plot %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data[[grouping_var]], Sample) %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[grouping_var]], name = "n")

  x_levels <- levels(df_plot[[grouping_var]])
  x_labels <- setNames(
    paste0(
      x_levels, "\n(n=",
      sapply(x_levels, function(lvl) {
        val <- counts %>% dplyr::filter(.data[[grouping_var]] == lvl) %>% dplyr::pull(n)
        if (length(val) == 0) 0 else val
      }),
      ")"
    ),
    nm = x_levels
  )

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = .data[[grouping_var]], y = Abundance, fill = .data[[grouping_var]])) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette_yesno, guide = "none") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    labs(
      x = "Any mucosa symptom",
      y = "Relative Abundance",
      title = paste("ASV:", asv)
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # Save
  safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", asv)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(safe_name, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 2.2,
    height = 3.6,
    units = "in"
  )
}
print(p)
```

#linear mixed effect model

```{r}
# ============================
# Setup
# ============================
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)     # lmer with Satterthwaite/Kenward-Roger p-values
library(broom.mixed)  # tidy() on lmer objects, includes p-values when lmerTest is loaded
library(stringr)

# ============================
# Extract and pre-filter metadata
# ============================
data <- data.frame(sample_data(PHYrar_alpha))

ids_to_filter <- c(
  "COV-T1-790","COV-T3-790","COV-T1-725","COV-T3-725","COV-T1-714","COV-T3-714",
  "COV-T2-670","COV-T3-670","COV-T1-641","COV-T3-641","COV-T1-564","COV-T3-564",
  "COV-T1-563","COV-T3-563","COV-T2-524","COV-T3-524","COV-T1-518","COV-T2-518",
  "COV-T2-516","COV-T3-516","COV-T1-510","COV-T3-510"
)

filtered_data <- data[data$id %in% ids_to_filter, , drop = FALSE]

# Keep only patients who have both Positive and Negative
positive_negative_patients <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  filter(all(c("Positive","Negative") %in% COVID_consensus)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Save metadata subset
if (!dir.exists("metadata")) dir.create("metadata", recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(positive_negative_patients, "metadata/positive_negative_patients.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# ============================
# Output dir by date
# ============================
current_date <- Sys.Date()
output_dir <- file.path("results", "temporal", current_date)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ============================
# Metrics to analyze
# ============================
metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

# Containers to collect summaries across metrics
all_models_summary <- list()      # compact summary for COVID effect
all_fixed_effects <- list()       # full fixed effects table for each metric (with p-values)

# ============================
# Loop over metrics (NO Visit_Number in the model)
# ============================
for (metric in metrics) {
  message("Processing metric: ", metric)

  # ----------------------------
  # Build model data for this metric
  # ----------------------------
  metric_model <- positive_negative_patients %>%
    dplyr::filter(COVID_consensus %in% c("Positive","Negative")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      COVID_consensus = factor(COVID_consensus, levels = c("Negative","Positive")), # reference = Negative
      Sex = factor(Sex),
      antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months),
      Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Patient_ID, Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months,
      COVID_consensus, dplyr::all_of(metric)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(value = dplyr::all_of(metric))

  # Keep complete cases for the model's columns
  complete_cols <- c("Patient_ID","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months",
                     "COVID_consensus","value")
  metric_model <- metric_model[complete.cases(metric_model[, complete_cols]), , drop = FALSE]

  # Safety checks
  if (nrow(metric_model) < 2 || length(unique(metric_model$COVID_consensus)) < 2) {
    warn_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("WARN_no_data_for_LME_", metric, "_", current_date, ".txt"))
    writeLines(c(
      paste0("Metric: ", metric),
      paste0("Rows after completeness filter: ", nrow(metric_model)),
      paste0("Levels in COVID_consensus: ", paste(unique(metric_model$COVID_consensus), collapse = ", ")),
      "Skipping LME due to insufficient complete cases or lack of both levels."
    ), con = warn_path)
    next
  }

 # ----------------------------
# Define paired values for plotting (one value per Patient x Status)
# ----------------------------
metric_pairs <- metric_model %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID, COVID_consensus) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Tabla ancha con delta explícito: delta = Negative - Positive
pair_wide <- metric_pairs %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = COVID_consensus, values_from = value) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Positive), !is.na(Negative)) %>%  # solo pacientes con ambos estados
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = Negative - Positive,
    change_direction_raw = dplyr::case_when(
      delta > 0  ~ "Decrease",  # bajó de Positive a Negative
      delta < 0  ~ "Increase",  # subió de Positive a Negative
      TRUE       ~ "NoChange"
    ),
    # Para el linetype, tratamos NoChange como Decrease (línea sólida)
    change_direction = ifelse(change_direction_raw == "NoChange", "Decrease", change_direction_raw)
  )

# Segmentos POS->NEG forzados (x=1 → xend=2)
segments_df <- pair_wide %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Patient_ID,
    change_direction,
    x = 1,            # Positive (izquierda)
    xend = 2,         # Negative (derecha)
    y = Positive,     # inicia en Positive
    yend = Negative   # termina en Negative
  )

# Datos para caja/puntos/labels (orden de eje fijo)
metric_plot <- metric_pairs %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(pair_wide, by = "Patient_ID") %>%  # mantiene solo pacientes completos
  dplyr::left_join(pair_wide %>% dplyr::select(Patient_ID, change_direction), by = "Patient_ID") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(COVID_consensus = factor(COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive","Negative")))

  # ----------------------------
  # LME with p-values (lmerTest) — NO Visit_Number
  # ----------------------------
  form <- as.formula(
    "value ~ COVID_consensus + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months + (1 | Patient_ID)"
  )
  fit <- lmer(form, data = metric_model, REML = TRUE)

  # Fixed effects (with CIs and p-values)
  tidy_tab <- broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)
  utils::write.csv(
    tidy_tab,
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("lme_fixed_effects_", metric, "_", current_date, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Pull COVID effect row (Positive vs Negative)
  covid_row <- tidy_tab %>% dplyr::filter(term == "COVID_consensusPositive")
  if (nrow(covid_row) == 0) {
    covid_row <- tidy_tab %>% dplyr::filter(grepl("^COVID_consensus", term))
  }

  beta <- covid_row$estimate[1]
  pval <- covid_row$p.value[1]

  # Compact summary row
  all_models_summary[[metric]] <- data.frame(
    metric = metric,
    term = covid_row$term[1],
    estimate = beta,
    std.error = covid_row$std.error[1],
    statistic = covid_row$statistic[1],
    p.value = pval,
    conf.low = covid_row$conf.low[1],
    conf.high = covid_row$conf.high[1],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # Plot (Positive=red, Negative=blue), robust segments Positive->Negative
  # ----------------------------
  plot <- ggplot(metric_plot, aes(x = COVID_consensus, y = value)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = COVID_consensus), width = 0.5) +
   geom_segment(
  data = segments_df,
  aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend, linetype = change_direction, group = Patient_ID),
  color = "gray30", linewidth = 1.2, alpha = 0.7, inherit.aes = FALSE
) +
geom_point(color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Positive", "Negative")) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Patient_ID), hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Positive", "Negative")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Increase" = "dashed", "Decrease" = "solid")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 1, "cm")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Metric:", metric, "by COVID Status (Paired Samples)"),
      subtitle = paste0("LME: COVID(Positive vs Negative) \u03B2=", signif(beta, 3),
                        ", p=", signif(pval, 3)),
      x = "COVID Status",
      y = metric,
      linetype = "Change Direction",
      fill = "COVID Status"
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_", metric, "_", current_date, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot,
    width = 5.5, height = 4
  )

  # ----------------------------
  # Direction counts
  # ----------------------------
  direction_counts <- dir_tab %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(change_direction)) %>%
    dplyr::count(change_direction, name = "n")

  utils::write.csv(
    direction_counts,
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("direction_counts_", metric, "_", current_date, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ============================
# Save compact summary across metrics
# ============================
if (length(all_models_summary) > 0) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(all_models_summary) %>%
    utils::write.csv(file.path(output_dir, paste0("lme_COVID_effect_summary_", current_date, ".csv")),
                     row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  writeLines("No models were fit (insufficient complete cases across all metrics).",
             con = file.path(output_dir, paste0("WARN_no_models_", current_date, ".txt")))
}

```

#ALPHA hannon, obs y simp
wilcoxon paired
y levene: homocedasticidad (no se considera lo pareado porque no se puede, así que se deja sencillo)

```{r}

#extract metdata
data <- data.frame(sample_data(PHYrar_alpha))
# Filter the data based on the IDs provided
ids_to_filter <- c("COV-T1-790", "COV-T3-790", "COV-T1-725", "COV-T3-725", "COV-T1-714", "COV-T3-714", 
                   "COV-T2-670", "COV-T3-670", "COV-T1-641", "COV-T3-641", "COV-T1-564", "COV-T3-564", 
                   "COV-T1-563", "COV-T3-563", "COV-T2-524", "COV-T3-524", "COV-T1-518", "COV-T2-518", 
                   "COV-T2-516", "COV-T3-516", "COV-T1-510", "COV-T3-510")

filtered_data <- data[data$id %in% ids_to_filter, ]

positive_negative_patients <- filtered_data %>% 
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% 
  filter("Positive" %in% COVID_consensus & "Negative" %in% COVID_consensus) %>% 
  ungroup()

#save
write.csv(positive_negative_patients, "metadata/positive_negative_patients.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# Definir la fecha actual para guardar los archivos
current_date <- Sys.Date()

# Crear la carpeta de resultados con la fecha actual si no existe
output_dir <- file.path("results", "temporal", current_date)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Definir las métricas a analizar
metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

# Iterar sobre las métricas
for (metric in metrics) {
  # Agregar una columna que indique la dirección del cambio por paciente
  metric_data <- positive_negative_patients %>%
    group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
    mutate(change_direction = ifelse(diff(.data[[metric]]) > 0, "Increase", "Decrease")) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Filtrar los datos emparejados para Wilcoxon test
  paired_data <- metric_data[metric_data$COVID_consensus %in% c("Positive", "Negative"), ]
  
  
  
  group_positive <- paired_data[[metric]][paired_data$COVID_consensus == "Positive"]
  group_negative <- paired_data[[metric]][paired_data$COVID_consensus == "Negative"]
  
  # Realizar el Wilcoxon test pareado
  wilcox_test <- wilcox.test(group_positive, group_negative, paired = TRUE)
  #sort levels COVID_consensus en metric_data
  metric_data$COVID_consensus <- factor(metric_data$COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
    
 plot <- ggplot(metric_data, aes(x = COVID_consensus, y = .data[[metric]])) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = COVID_consensus), width = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID, linetype = change_direction), 
              color = "gray30", size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +  # puntos en negro
    geom_text(aes(label = Patient_ID), hjust = -0.3, vjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Increase" = "dashed", "Decrease" = "solid")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 2, 1, 1, "cm")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Metric:", metric, "by COVID Status (Paired Samples)"),
      subtitle = paste("Wilcoxon paired test p-value =", round(wilcox_test$p.value, 4)),
      x = "COVID Status",
      y = metric,
      linetype = "Change Direction",
      fill = "COVID Status"
    )


  
  # Guardar el gráfico
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_", metric, "_", current_date, ".pdf")),
    plot = plot,
    width = 5.5, height = 4
  )
  
  # Calcular la cantidad de aumentos y disminuciones
  direction_counts <- metric_data %>%
    group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
    summarise(direction = ifelse(diff(.data[[metric]]) > 0, "Increase", "Decrease")) %>%
    count(direction)
  
  # Guardar el conteo de direcciones
  write.csv(
    direction_counts,
    file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("direction_counts_", metric, "_", current_date, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Renombrar la métrica para que sea compatible con leveneTest
metric_data <- metric_data %>%
  rename(current_metric = all_of(metric))
```

#levene equivalence for variance

```{r}
# convertir los datos a formato pareado

library(tidyr)

# 1. Extraer metadata desde objeto phyloseq
data <- data.frame(sample_data(PHYrar_alpha))

# 2. Filtrar por IDs relevantes (los que tienen visitas específicas)
ids_to_filter <- c(
  "COV-T1-790", "COV-T3-790", "COV-T1-725", "COV-T3-725", "COV-T1-714", "COV-T3-714", 
  "COV-T2-670", "COV-T3-670", "COV-T1-641", "COV-T3-641", "COV-T1-564", "COV-T3-564",

  "COV-T2-516", "COV-T3-516", "COV-T1-510", "COV-T3-510"
)

filtered_data <- data %>%
  filter(id %in% ids_to_filter)

# 3. Filtrar pacientes con una muestra "Positive" y una "Negative"
paired <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(COVID_consensus %in% c("Positive", "Negative")) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID, COVID_consensus) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # tomar solo una muestra por estado
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>%  # asegurar que haya un par completo
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(shannon_rar_asv))  # eliminar casos sin valor de Shannon

# 4. Convertir a formato wide para análisis pareado
wide <- paired %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, COVID_consensus, shannon_rar_asv) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = COVID_consensus, values_from = shannon_rar_asv)

# 5. Test de varianza pareada (Pitman-Morgan)
cat("\n📉 Pitman-Morgan Test (Varianza pareada):\n")
print(var.test(wide$Positive, wide$Negative, paired = TRUE))

# 6. Test t pareado (media de Shannon)
cat("\n📊 t-test pareado (Media de Shannon):\n")
print(t.test(wide$Positive, wide$Negative, paired = TRUE))

#ahora para obs_rar_asv 
# 4. Convertir a formato wide para análisis pareado
wide_obs <- paired %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, COVID_consensus, obs_rar_asv) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = COVID_consensus, values_from = obs_rar_asv)
# 5. Test de varianza pareada (Pitman-Morgan)
cat("\n📉 Pitman-Morgan Test (Varianza pareada) - obs_rar_asv:\n")
print(var.test(wide_obs$Positive, wide_obs$Negative, paired = TRUE))
# 6. Test t pareado (media de obs_rar_asv)
cat("\n📊 t-test pareado (Media de obs_rar_asv):\n")
```

# días vs alpha all metrics pearson corr
A
```{r}
# Cargar las librerías necesarias
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Definir la fecha actual para guardar los archivos
current_date <- Sys.Date()

# Crear la carpeta de resultados con la fecha actual si no existe
output_dir <- file.path("results", "corr", current_date)
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Definir las métricas a analizar
metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

# Iterar sobre las métricas
results <- list()

for (metric in metrics) {
  # Filtrar visitas negativas de COVID y seleccionar la métrica actual
  negative_visits <- filtered_data %>%
    filter(COVID_consensus == "Negative") %>%
    select(Patient_ID, days_btw_visits, all_of(metric), Date_of_Visit) %>%
    arrange(days_btw_visits)
  

  # Crear scatter plot
  plot <- ggplot(negative_visits, aes(x = days_btw_visits, y = .data[[metric]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue", se = TRUE) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Relationship between Days and", metric, "in Negative COVID Samples"),
      x = "Days when Sample was Negative",
      y = metric
    )
  
  # Guardar el gráfico
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0("plot_", metric, "_", current_date, ".png")),
    plot = plot,
    width = 8, height = 6
  )
  
  # Calcular correlación
  correlation <- cor.test(negative_visits$days_btw_visits, negative_visits[[metric]])
  
  # Guardar los resultados en la lista
  results[[metric]] <- list(
    summary = summary(negative_visits),
    correlation = correlation
  )
  
  # Guardar los resultados de la correlación en un archivo
  sink(file.path(output_dir, paste0("correlation_", metric, "_", current_date, ".txt")))
  cat("Summary statistics for", metric, ":\n")
  print(summary(negative_visits))
  cat("\nCorrelation test results for", metric, ":\n")
  print(correlation)
  sink()
}

# Fin del script
print(paste("Análisis completado. Gráficos y resultados guardados en:", output_dir))

```

```{r}
# 3. Filtrar pacientes que tengan al menos un positivo y un negativo

patients_df$COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj
# 4. Subset para visitas relevantes
patients_temporal <- subset(patients_df, Visit_Number %in% c('First_Visit', 'Second_Visit', 'Third_Visit'))

# 5. Convertir métricas y días a numérico
patients_temporal$shannon_rar_asv <- as.numeric(as.character(patients_temporal$shannon_rar_asv))

longitudinal_data <- subset(patients_temporal, Patient_ID %in% patients_with_followup)

# 9. Ordenar data

# 10. Resumen

# 12. Gráfico Shannon

# 13. Gráfico Observed
```

```{r}
# 0. Cargar paquetes necesarios
# install.packages(c("phyloseq", "vegan", "microbiome", "dplyr", "ggplot2"))
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome) # Para la transformación CLR
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- TU OBJETO PHYLOSEQ COMPLETO SE LLAMA PHYrar_alpha ---
# PHYrar_alpha <- readRDS("tu_objeto_phyloseq_con_conteos.rds") # Ejemplo de carga

# 1. Preparación del Objeto Phyloseq y Metadatos
# No es necesario extraer data_meta_full si no se usa después.

ids_to_filter <- c("COV-T1-790", "COV-T3-790", "COV-T1-725", "COV-T3-725", "COV-T1-714", "COV-T3-714", 
                   "COV-T2-670", "COV-T3-670", "COV-T1-641", "COV-T3-641", "COV-T1-564", "COV-T3-564", 
                   "COV-T1-563", "COV-T3-563", "COV-T2-524", "COV-T3-524", "COV-T1-518", "COV-T2-518", 
                   "COV-T2-516", "COV-T3-516", "COV-T1-510", "COV-T3-510")

# Filtrar el objeto phyloseq completo (PHYrar_alpha)
PHY_filtered <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, id %in% ids_to_filter)

# Extraer los metadatos filtrados (importante para PERMANOVA)
filtered_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(PHY_filtered))
filtered_metadata$Patient_ID <- as.factor(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID)
filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus <- factor(filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))

# Verificar que cada paciente tenga las dos condiciones (Positive, Negative)
patient_counts <- table(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID)
patients_with_pairs <- names(patient_counts[patient_counts == 2])

# Filtrar PHY_filtered y filtered_metadata para asegurar que solo se incluyan pacientes con pares exactos
if (length(patients_with_pairs) < length(unique(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID))) {
  warning("Algunos pacientes no tienen exactamente dos muestras después del filtrado inicial. Filtrando a solo pacientes con pares.")
  PHY_filtered <- subset_samples(PHY_filtered, Patient_ID %in% patients_with_pairs)
  # Actualizar filtered_metadata después de filtrar PHY_filtered
  filtered_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(PHY_filtered))
  filtered_metadata$Patient_ID <- as.factor(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID)
  filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus <- factor(filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
}
cat("Número de muestras después de asegurar pares:", nsamples(PHY_filtered), "\n")
cat("Pacientes únicos con pares:", paste(unique(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID), collapse=", "), "\n")


# 2. Transformación CLR
# Primero, asegúrate de que la tabla de OTU no esté vacía y no tenga muestras con suma cero
if(any(sample_sums(PHY_filtered) == 0)){
    PHY_filtered <- prune_samples(sample_sums(PHY_filtered) > 0, PHY_filtered)
    warning("Se eliminaron muestras con cero conteos totales antes de la transformación CLR.")
    # Actualizar metadatos si se eliminaron muestras
    filtered_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(PHY_filtered))
    filtered_metadata$Patient_ID <- as.factor(filtered_metadata$Patient_ID)
    filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus <- factor(filtered_metadata$COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))
}
PHY_transformed_clr <- microbiome::transform(PHY_filtered, 'clr', target = "otu_table")


# 3. Cálculo de la Distancia de Aitchison
dist_aitchison <- phyloseq::distance(PHY_transformed_clr, method = "euclidean")


# 4. Ejecución de PERMANOVA Pareada
# Usar los metadatos del objeto phyloseq ya transformado y filtrado (PHY_transformed_clr)
metadata_for_permanova <- data.frame(sample_data(PHY_transformed_clr))
# Asegurar que los factores están correctamente definidos (ya se hizo en filtered_metadata, pero reasegurar aquí)
metadata_for_permanova$Patient_ID <- as.factor(metadata_for_permanova$Patient_ID)
metadata_for_permanova$COVID_consensus <- factor(metadata_for_permanova$COVID_consensus, levels = c("Positive", "Negative"))

print(table(metadata_for_permanova$Patient_ID, metadata_for_permanova$COVID_consensus))

set.seed(123) # Para reproducibilidad de PERMANOVA y NMDS
permanova_result <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist_aitchison ~ COVID_consensus,
  data = metadata_for_permanova,
  permutations = 999, 
  strata = metadata_for_permanova$Patient_ID
)
print(permanova_result)

# Guardar resultados
current_date <- Sys.Date()
output_dir_beta <- file.path("results", "temporal/beta", format(current_date, "%Y-%m-%d"))
if (!dir.exists(output_dir_beta)) {
  dir.create(output_dir_beta, recursive = TRUE)
}

permanova_output_file <- file.path(output_dir_beta, "permanova_aitchison_paired_results.txt")
sink(permanova_output_file)
print("Resultados de PERMANOVA Pareada (Aitchison) para COVID_consensus, estratificado por Patient_ID")
print(permanova_result)
sink()
cat("Resultados de PERMANOVA guardados en:", permanova_output_file, "\n")


# 5. Visualización (NMDS)
set.seed(123) # Para reproducibilidad del NMDS

# Calcular NMDS directamente usando vegan::metaMDS para un control más claro del stress y los puntos
# autotransform = FALSE es importante porque dist_aitchison ya es una matriz de distancias
nmds_aitchison_direct <- vegan::metaMDS(dist_aitchison, k = 2, trymax = 100, autotransform = FALSE, wascores = FALSE, noshare=FALSE)
nmds_stress_value <- nmds_aitchison_direct$stress 
cat("NMDS Stress:", round(nmds_stress_value, 4), "\n")

# Para graficar con ggplot, extraemos los puntos ("sites") y los combinamos con los metadatos
nmds_points_df <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds_aitchison_direct, display = "sites"))
colnames(nmds_points_df) <- c("NMDS1", "NMDS2") # Renombrar ejes

# Asegurarse de que los rownames de nmds_points_df (que son sample IDs)
# coincidan con los de metadata_for_permanova para unir correctamente.
# vegan::scores debería mantener el orden o los nombres de las muestras de la matriz de distancia.
# Si dist_aitchison se creó a partir de PHY_transformed_clr, los nombres de las muestras deben coincidir.
# sample_names(PHY_transformed_clr) debería ser el orden de referencia.
if(!all(rownames(nmds_points_df) == sample_names(PHY_transformed_clr))){
    # Esto sería inusual si dist_aitchison se generó correctamente
    warning("El orden de las muestras en NMDS no coincide con PHY_transformed_clr. Intentando reordenar.")
    nmds_points_df <- nmds_points_df[match(sample_names(PHY_transformed_clr), rownames(nmds_points_df)), ]
}

nmds_df_plot <- cbind(nmds_points_df, metadata_for_permanova)


# Verificar que Patient_ID es factor para el group en geom_line
nmds_df_plot$Patient_ID <- as.factor(nmds_df_plot$Patient_ID) 

# Plot
beta_plot_nmds <- ggplot(nmds_df_plot, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = COVID_consensus)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "grey50", linetype = "solid", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Positive" = "#ff6347", "Negative" = "#5a9bd4")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS (Distancia de Aitchison)",
    subtitle = paste("PERMANOVA pareada: R2 =", round(permanova_result$R2[1], 3),
                     ", p-value =", round(permanova_result$`Pr(>F)`[1], 4),
                     "\nNMDS Stress =", round(nmds_stress_value, 4)),
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2",
    color = "Estado COVID-19"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=9))

print(beta_plot_nmds)

# Guardar el gráfico
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir_beta, "nmds_aitchison_paired.pdf"),
  plot = beta_plot_nmds,
  width = 6, 
  height = 6, 
  dpi = 300
)
cat("Gráfico NMDS guardado en:", file.path(output_dir_beta, "nmds_aitchison_paired.pdf"), "\n")
```

```{r}
data1 <- subset(data, Patient_ID %in% patients_with_3visits)
#exclude outliers in days btw visits
data1 <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(Patient_ID == "P_23"))

dim(data1)
#plot distribution of days between visits
ggplot(data1, aes(x=adjusted_days_btw_visits)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=10, fill="blue", color="black", alpha=0.7) +
  labs(title="Distribution of Adjusted Days Between Visits",
       x="Adjusted Days Between Visits",
       y="Frequency") +
  theme_bw()

#dame la media y la mediana de days btw visits para cada visita
data1 %>%
  group_by(Visit_Number) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_days = mean(adjusted_days_btw_visits, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_days = median(adjusted_days_btw_visits, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_days = sd(adjusted_days_btw_visits, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

# alpha No covid: linear model de no vacunacion en visita 1 o 2 pero sí en vista 2 o 3
lo importante es que la primera muestra sea no vacunada y la segunda sí vacunada, no importa si es la 2 o la 3
```{r}
# ============================
# Setup
# ============================
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)

# ============================
# Excluir COVID cases y embarazadas (si existe la variable)
# ============================
phy <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)

# manejar 'pregnant' o 'Pregnant'
preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy <- subset_samples(phy, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# ============================
# Extraer metadata y quedarnos con nunca COVID+
# ============================
data <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
data <- subset(data, COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No")

# ============================
# Usar visitas 1, 2 y 3
# ============================
data_123 <- subset(data, Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit"))

# Normalizar variable EVER a Yes/No por si hay variantes
data_123 <- data_123 %>%
  mutate(
    vax_ever = case_when(
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("Yes","YES","yes","Y") ~ "Yes",
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("No","NO","no","N") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)
    ),
    vax_ever = factor(vax_ever, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# ============================
# Seleccionar pacientes:
#   (First = No y (Second = Yes o Third = Yes))  OR  (Second = No y Third = Yes)
# ============================
wide_vax <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, vax_ever) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = vax_ever)

ids_target <- wide_vax %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    (First_Visit == "No" & (Second_Visit == "Yes" | Third_Visit == "Yes")) |
    (Second_Visit == "No" & Third_Visit == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Patient_ID) %>%
  unique()

# ---- Pareo No/Yes por paciente ----
# 1) "No" preferentemente de First=No; si no hay, usar Second=No (sólo si Third=Yes)
first_no <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "First_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

second_no_only <- data_123 %>%                        # candidatos a usar Second como "No"
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "No") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(Patient_ID %in% first_no$Patient_ID)) %>%    # sólo quienes NO tienen First=No
  dplyr::semi_join(                                         # y que en wide tienen Third=Yes
    wide_vax %>% dplyr::filter(Third_Visit == "Yes"),
    by = "Patient_ID"
  )

no_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(first_no, second_no_only)

# 2) "Yes": tomar la más temprana disponible (Second si Yes; si no, Third=Yes)
second_yes <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "Yes")

third_yes <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "Third_Visit", vax_ever == "Yes",
                !(Patient_ID %in% second_yes$Patient_ID))

yes_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(second_yes, third_yes)

# 3) Dataset final pareado: exactamente dos filas por paciente (No y Yes)
data_vax_change <- dplyr::bind_rows(no_rows, yes_rows) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Patient_ID, vax_ever)


# ============================
# Run plots + LME for two metrics
# ============================
if (!dir.exists("results/temporal/alpha")) dir.create("results/temporal/alpha", recursive = TRUE)

metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

for (metric in metrics) {
  message("Processing metric: ", metric)

  # Prep per-metric dataframe
  df <- data_vax_change %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sex = factor(Sex),
      antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months),
      Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.data[[metric]], Age, BMI, Sex,
                                 antibiotics_last_2months, vax_ever, Patient_ID))

  # Need both levels of vax_ever
  if (length(unique(na.omit(df$vax_ever))) < 2) {
    warning("Skipping metric ", metric, ": not both vax_ever levels present after filtering.")
    next
  }

  # n per group and label height
  n_counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(vax_ever) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      y = max(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  y_margin <- diff(range(df[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.05

  # Plot with spaghetti lines
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = vax_ever, y = .data[[metric]], fill = vax_ever)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.65) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "gray40", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_text(
      data = n_counts,
      aes(x = vax_ever, y = y + y_margin, label = paste0("n=", n)),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Alpha diversity by vaccination status (No → Yes using 2nd/3rd)\nMetric: ", metric),
      x = "Vaccination ever status",
      y = metric
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("results/temporal/alpha",
                         paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                "_spaghetti_box_by_vaxEVER_FirstOrSecondNo_thenYes_", metric, ".pdf")),
    plot = p, width = 3.6, height = 5
  )
  print(p)

  # LME per metric
  form <- as.formula(paste0(
    metric, " ~ vax_ever + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months + (1 | Patient_ID)"
  ))
  po <- lmer(form, data = df, REML = TRUE)
  print(summary(po))

  capture.output(
    summary(po),
    file = file.path("results/temporal/alpha",
                     paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                            "_lmm_by_vaxEVER_FirstOrSecondNo_thenYes_", metric, ".txt"))
  )
}


```
