```{r}
# ============================
# Construir cohorte: First vs (Second o Third) SOLO no vacunados
# Regla: si el paciente tiene 2 y 3, usar Second (solo 1 comparación por paciente)
# ============================

# Extraer metadata del phy ya filtrado (tu bloque previo)
meta_all <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
meta_all$SampleID <- rownames(meta_all)

# Normalizar vacunación EVER a Yes/No y quedarnos con visitas 1-3
meta_123 <- meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vax_ever = dplyr::case_when(
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("Yes","YES","yes","Y") ~ "Yes",
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("No","NO","no","N") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)
    ),
    vax_ever = factor(vax_ever, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# Ensamblar tabla ancha para checar presencia por visita y estado de vacuna
wide_nv <- meta_123 %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, vax_ever) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = vax_ever)

# IDs elegibles:
# - Deben tener First_Visit = No
# - Y además: (Second_Visit = No)  O  (no Second pero Third_Visit = No)
ids_target <- wide_nv %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    First_Visit == "No" &
      (Second_Visit == "No" | (is.na(Second_Visit) & Third_Visit == "No"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Patient_ID) %>%
  unique()

# Fila "No" baseline: First_Visit == No
first_no <- meta_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "First_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

# Fila "post" preferente: Second_Visit == No si existe
second_no <- meta_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

# Si un paciente NO tiene Second_Visit = No, usar Third_Visit = No
third_no <- meta_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
                Visit_Number == "Third_Visit", vax_ever == "No",
                !(Patient_ID %in% second_no$Patient_ID))


# Post "No" (solo una por paciente: Second si existe, si no Third)
post_no <- dplyr::bind_rows(second_no, third_no)

# Dataset final pareado (exactamente dos filas por paciente)
data_nv_pair <- dplyr::bind_rows(first_no, post_no) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Patient_ID, Visit_Number) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Collapse Second_Visit and Third_Visit into Post_Visit
    Visit_Number = dplyr::case_when(
      Visit_Number %in% c("Second_Visit","Third_Visit") ~ "Post_Visit",
      TRUE ~ Visit_Number
    ),
    Visit_Number = factor(Visit_Number, levels = c("First_Visit","Post_Visit")),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months),
    Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID)
  )

# Chequeo de seguridad: 2 filas por paciente y ambos son "No"
stopifnot(all(table(data_nv_pair$Patient_ID) == 2))
stopifnot(all(data_nv_pair$vax_ever == "No"))

# ============================
# Plot + LME para métricas (First vs Post)
# ============================
if (!dir.exists("results/temporal/alpha_noVax_pairs")) {
  dir.create("results/temporal/alpha_noVax_pairs", recursive = TRUE)
}
metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

for (metric in metrics) {
  message("Processing never-vax paired metric: ", metric)

  df <- data_nv_pair %>%
    dplyr::filter(complete.cases(.data[[metric]], Age, BMI, Sex,
                                 antibiotics_last_2months, Visit_Number, Patient_ID))

  # asegurar que cada paciente tenga exactamente First y Post
df <- df %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  filter(all(c("First_Visit","Post_Visit") %in% Visit_Number)) %>%
  ungroup()

  # n por visita y altura para 'n'
  n_counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Visit_Number) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), y = max(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  y_margin <- diff(range(df[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.05

  # Spaghetti boxplot (First vs Post)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Visit_Number, y = .data[[metric]], fill = Visit_Number)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "gray40", alpha = 0.65, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.4, alpha = 0.95, color = "black") +
    geom_text(data = n_counts,
              aes(x = Visit_Number, y = y + y_margin, label = paste0("n=", n)),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Alpha diversity (Never vaccinated): First vs Post (2/3)\nMetric: ", metric),
      x = "Visit Number",
      y = metric
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("results/temporal/alpha_noVax_pairs",
                         paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                "_neverVax_First_vs_Post_spaghetti_", metric, ".pdf")),
    plot = p, width = 4.2, height = 5
  )
  print(p)

  # LME: Visit_Number + covariables + (1|Patient_ID)
  df$Visit_Number <- droplevels(df$Visit_Number)
  if (nlevels(df$Visit_Number) < 2) {
    warning("Skip LME for ", metric, ": Visit_Number tiene <2 niveles tras filtrado.")
    next
  }

  form <- as.formula(paste0(
    metric, " ~ Visit_Number + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months + (1 | Patient_ID)"
  ))
  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(form, data = df, REML = TRUE)
  print(summary(fit))

  capture.output(
    summary(fit),
    file = file.path("results/temporal/alpha_noVax_pairs",
                     paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                            "_neverVax_First_vs_Post_LMM_", metric, ".txt"))
  )
}
```

#alpha ahora juntando los que en el 2do timepoint no se vac y sí se vacunaron para ver si la pendiente es diferente

```{r}
# ============================
# Setup
# ============================
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)    
library(ggrepel)
# for marginal means and contrasts
# optional for R2 of mixed models:
# library(performance)

# ============================
# Exclude COVID cases and pregnant (if present)
# ============================
phy <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)

preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy <- subset_samples(phy, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# ============================
# Extract metadata and keep never COVID+
# ============================
data <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
data <- subset(data, COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No")

# ============================
# Keep visits 1,2,3 + normalize vaccination (row-wise)
# ============================
data_123 <- subset(data, Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vax_raw = tolower(as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)),
    vax_ever_row = dplyr::case_when(
      vax_raw %in% c("yes","y") ~ "Yes",
      vax_raw %in% c("no","n")  ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_                 # NO imputar
    ),
    vax_ever_row = factor(vax_ever_row, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# ============================
# Build paired: BEFORE=First; AFTER=Second si existe, si no Third
# ============================
wide_vis <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(has_visit = TRUE) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = has_visit, values_fill = FALSE)

eligible_ids <- wide_vis %>%
  dplyr::filter(First_Visit, (Second_Visit | Third_Visit)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Patient_ID)

before_rows <- data_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "First_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("Before", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row, days_btw_visits,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

after_second <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "Second_Visit") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row, days_btw_visits,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

ids_without_second <- setdiff(eligible_ids, unique(after_second$Patient_ID))

after_third <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_without_second, Visit_Number == "Third_Visit") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row, days_btw_visits,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

paired <- dplyr::bind_rows(before_rows, after_second, after_third) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Patient_ID, Period) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>%   # asegurar 1 Before + 1 After
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months),
    Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID)
  )

# ============================
# PostVaccinated (sin imputar NA) y propagar al Before
# ============================
paired <- paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    PostVaccinated = dplyr::case_when(
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "No"  ~ "No",
      Period == "After" & is.na(vax_ever_row)   ~ NA_character_,
      Period == "Before"                        ~ NA_character_
    ),
    PostVaccinated = ifelse(Period == "Before",
                            PostVaccinated[Period == "After"],
                            PostVaccinated)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(PostVaccinated = factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes")))

message("N patients with pairs (pre-screen): ", length(unique(paired$Patient_ID)))
print(table(paired$Period))
print(table(After_is_vaccinated = paired$PostVaccinated[paired$Period == "After"], useNA = "ifany"))

# ============================
# Output dir
# ============================
out_dir <- "results/temporal/alpha_before_after_by_postvax"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

colnames(paired)
table(paired1$Period, paired1$PostVaccinated)

#remove na BMI
paired1=subset(paired, !is.na(paired$antibiotics_last_2months) & !is.na(paired$BMI) & !is.na(paired$PostVaccinated))
paired2 <- paired1 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
table(paired2$Period, paired2$PostVaccinated)
paired2 %>% 
  select(Patient_ID, Period, PostVaccinated)
# ============================
# Metrics
# ============================
metrics <- c("shannon_rar_asv", "simpson_rar_asv", "obs_rar_asv")

for (metric in metrics) {
  message("Processing metric: ", metric)

  # --- Keep ALL columns: do not select a subset here ---
  base_pairs <- paired

  # Filter only on the few fields we require (do not drop other columns)
  rows_ok <- base_pairs %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data[[metric]]),
      !is.na(Age), !is.na(BMI),
      !is.na(Sex), !is.na(antibiotics_last_2months),
      !is.na(PostVaccinated)
      # NOTE: we do NOT require days_btw_visits to be non-NA here
    )

  df <- rows_ok %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  if (nrow(df) < 10 || length(unique(df$Patient_ID)) < 5 || length(unique(df$PostVaccinated)) < 2) {
    warning("Skipping metric ", metric, ": insufficient data after strict pairing.")
    next
  }

  df$Period01 <- ifelse(df$Period == "After", 1, 0)
  df$Patient_ID <- as.character(df$Patient_ID)
  # ============================
  # (A) Spaghetti (IDs + n)
  # ============================
  n_counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Period, PostVaccinated) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                     y = max(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop")
  y_margin <- diff(range(df[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.05

  p_spag <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Period, y = .data[[metric]], group = Patient_ID, color = PostVaccinated)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text(data = dplyr::filter(df, Period == "After"),
              aes(label = Patient_ID),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 2.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3, shape = 18,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.3),
                 aes(group = interaction(PostVaccinated, Period))) +
    geom_text(data = n_counts,
              aes(x = Period, y = y + y_margin, label = paste0("n=", n), color = PostVaccinated),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Alpha diversity: Before vs After by PostVaccinated\nMetric: ", metric),
      x = "Period", y = metric, color = "After is post-vaccine?"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                   "_spaghetti_BeforeAfter_byPostVax_", metric, ".pdf")),
         p_spag, width = 5.6, height = 4.4)

  # ============================
  # (B) Delta (After − Before) (IDs + n)
  # ============================
  wide_metric <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Period, PostVaccinated, !!rlang::sym(metric)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Period, values_from = !!rlang::sym(metric))
  deltas <- wide_metric %>% dplyr::mutate(Delta = After - Before)
  deltas$Patient_ID <- as.character(deltas$Patient_ID)

  n_counts_delta <- deltas %>%
    dplyr::group_by(PostVaccinated) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(),
                     y = max(Delta, na.rm = TRUE),
                     .groups = "drop")
  y_margin_delta <- diff(range(deltas$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)) * 0.05

  p_delta <- ggplot(deltas, aes(x = PostVaccinated, y = Delta, fill = PostVaccinated)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.9, color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Patient_ID),
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 2.3, color = "black") +
    geom_text(data = n_counts_delta,
              aes(x = PostVaccinated, y = y + y_margin_delta, label = paste0("n=", n)),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Per-patient change (After − Before) by PostVaccinated\nMetric: ", metric),
      x = "After is post-vaccine?", y = "Delta (After − Before)"
    ) +
    theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                   "_delta_box_ids_byPostVax_", metric, ".pdf")),
         p_delta, width = 4.8, height = 4.6)

  # ============================
  # (C) Modelo mixto + EMMEANS (plot ±95% CI + n)
  # ============================
  form_int <- as.formula(paste0(
    metric, " ~ Period01 * PostVaccinated + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months + (1 | Patient_ID)"
  ))
  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(form_int, data = df, REML = TRUE)
  sm <- summary(fit); print(sm)

  capture.output(
    sm,
    file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                     "_LME_PeriodXPostVax_", metric, ".txt"))
  )
  an <- anova(fit, type = 3)
  capture.output(
    an,
    file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                     "_ANOVA_type3_PeriodXPostVax_", metric, ".txt"))
  )

  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Period01 | PostVaccinated)

  # Guardar tablas principales (sin gráficos de medias/SD)
  change_within <- emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "PostVaccinated") # After − Before por grupo
  capture.output(emm,           file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                                                 "_EMMEANS_Period_byPostVax_", metric, ".txt")))
  capture.output(change_within, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                                                 "_CHANGE_within_groups_", metric, ".txt")))

  # Preparar datos para plot de EMMEANS con 'n'
  emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Period = factor(ifelse(Period01 == 0, "Before", "After"),
                      levels = c("Before", "After")),
      PostVaccinated = factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes"))
    )
  n_counts_emm <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Before","After")),
      PostVaccinated = factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes"))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::count(Period, PostVaccinated, name = "n")
  emm_df <- dplyr::left_join(emm_df, n_counts_emm, by = c("Period","PostVaccinated"))

  p_emm <- ggplot(emm_df, aes(x = Period,
                              y = emmean,
                              group = PostVaccinated,
                              color = PostVaccinated)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.25), size = 2.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                  width = 0.12, position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)) +
    geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.25)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.25),
              vjust = -1.2, size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Marginal means (±95% CI) by PostVaccinated\nMetric: ", metric),
      x = "Period",
      y = "Estimated mean (adjusted)",
      color = "After is post-vaccine?"
    ) +
    theme_bw()

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                         "_EMMEANS_plot_Period_byPostVax_", metric, ".pdf")),
    plot = p_emm, width = 5.2, height = 4.6
  )
}
```

#beta No covid: no vacunacion en visita 1 o 2 pero sí en vista 2 o 3
```{r}
# 0. Paquetes
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome) # CLR
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================
# 1) Filtrado de muestras (COVID cases y embarazadas si existe variable)
# ============================
phy <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)

preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy <- subset_samples(phy, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# ============================
# 2) Metadatos base (nunca COVID+) y visitas 1-2-3
# ============================
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

# Solo nunca COVID+
meta <- subset(meta, COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No")

# Sólo visitas 1,2,3
meta123 <- subset(meta, Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit"))

# Normalizar vacunación EVER a Yes/No
meta123 <- meta123 %>%
  mutate(
    vax_ever = case_when(
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("Yes","YES","yes","Y") ~ "Yes",
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("No","NO","no","N") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)
    ),
    vax_ever = factor(vax_ever, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# ============================
# 3) Criterios de inclusión (pares No→Yes)
#    (First=No & (Second=Yes | Third=Yes))  OR  (Second=No & Third=Yes)
# ============================
wide_vax <- meta123 %>%
  select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, vax_ever) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = vax_ever)

ids_target <- wide_vax %>%
  filter(
    (First_Visit == "No" & (Second_Visit == "Yes" | Third_Visit == "Yes")) |
    (Second_Visit == "No" & Third_Visit == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  pull(Patient_ID) %>%
  unique()

# ---- Pareo No/Yes por paciente ----
# NO: preferir First=No; si no, usar Second=No (sólo si Third=Yes)
first_no <- meta123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "First_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

second_no_only <- meta123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "No") %>%
  filter(!(Patient_ID %in% first_no$Patient_ID)) %>%
  semi_join(wide_vax %>% filter(Third_Visit == "Yes"), by = "Patient_ID")

no_rows <- bind_rows(first_no, second_no_only)

# YES: más temprano disponible (Second=Yes si existe; si no, Third=Yes)
second_yes <- meta123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "Yes")

third_yes <- meta123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "Third_Visit", vax_ever == "Yes",
         !(Patient_ID %in% second_yes$Patient_ID))

yes_rows <- bind_rows(second_yes, third_yes)

# Dataset final pareado: exactamente 2 filas por paciente
meta_paired <- bind_rows(no_rows, yes_rows) %>%
  arrange(Patient_ID, vax_ever)
meta_paired$Patient_ID

# Seguridad: verificar 2 filas por paciente y ambos niveles
stopifnot(all(table(meta_paired$Patient_ID) == 2))
stopifnot(all(levels(meta_paired$vax_ever) %in% c("No","Yes")))
if (length(unique(na.omit(meta_paired$vax_ever))) < 2) {
  stop("El subconjunto no tiene ambos niveles de vax_ever (No/Yes). Revisa filtros.")
}

# ============================
# 4) Subset del objeto phyloseq a las muestras pareadas y CLR
# ============================
# Nos quedamos con las muestras (SampleID) del meta_paired
phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_names(phy) %in% meta_paired$SampleID, phy)

# Extraer metadata del objeto phy_sel
meta_tmp <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_sel))
meta_tmp$SampleID <- rownames(meta_tmp)

# Identificar Patient_ID con al menos un NA en Age, BMI, Sex o antibiotics_last_2months
bad_patients <- meta_tmp %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(Age) | is.na(BMI) | is.na(Sex) | is.na(antibiotics_last_2months)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Patient_ID) %>%
  unique()

cat("Pacientes eliminados por tener NAs:", bad_patients, "\n")

# Filtrar phyloseq quitando esos pacientes
phy_sel <- subset_samples(phy_sel, !(Patient_ID %in% bad_patients))
phy_sel
# Eliminar muestras con suma 0 si las hubiera
if (any(sample_sums(phy_sel) == 0)) {
  phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_sel) > 0, phy_sel)
}

# CLR sobre otu_table
phy_clr <- microbiome::transform(phy_sel, 'clr', target = "otu_table")

# ============================
# 5) Distancia de Aitchison
# ============================
dist_ait <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr, method = "euclidean")

# Metadatos sincronizados (desde phy_clr para asegurar orden)
meta_for_beta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_clr))
meta_for_beta$Patient_ID <- factor(meta_for_beta$Patient_ID)
# traemos vax_ever desde meta_paired por SampleID
meta_for_beta$SampleID <- rownames(meta_for_beta)
meta_for_beta <- left_join(meta_for_beta,
                           meta_paired[, c("SampleID","vax_ever")],
                           by = "SampleID")
meta_for_beta$vax_ever <- factor(meta_for_beta$vax_ever, levels = c("No","Yes"))

# ============================
# 6) PERMANOVA pareada (strata = Patient_ID)
# ============================
# Remove NA cases from covariates
meta_for_beta <- meta_for_beta %>%
  dplyr::filter(complete.cases(vax_ever,Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months))
meta_for_beta$Patient_ID
set.seed(123)
perma <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist_ait ~ vax_ever+ Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months,
  data = meta_for_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_for_beta$Patient_ID,
  by = "margin"
)
print(perma)

# ============================
# 7) NMDS y visualización
# ============================
set.seed(123)
nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(dist_ait, k = 2, trymax = 100,
                       autotransform = FALSE, wascores = FALSE, noshare = FALSE)
stress_val <- nmds$stress

nmds_pts <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
colnames(nmds_pts) <- c("NMDS1","NMDS2")
# Alinear con sample_names(phy_clr) si hiciera falta
if (!all(rownames(nmds_pts) == sample_names(phy_clr))) {
  nmds_pts <- nmds_pts[match(sample_names(phy_clr), rownames(nmds_pts)), ]
}
plot_df <- cbind(nmds_pts, meta_for_beta)

# Plot spaghetti (líneas por paciente) coloreado por vax_ever
beta_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, fill = vax_ever)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +   # borde negro
  geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "grey55", alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS (Aitchison) - Pares No->Yes (2a o 3a)",
    subtitle = paste0("PERMANOVA (paired): R2 = ",
                      round(perma$R2[1], 3),
                      ", p = ",
                      formatC(perma$`Pr(>F)`[1], format = "f", digits = 4),
                      " | Stress = ", round(stress_val, 4)),
    x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", fill = "Vaccination (ever)"
  ) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = vax_ever), type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9))

# ============================
# 8) Guardar resultados
# ============================
current_date <- Sys.Date()
out_dir <- file.path("results", "temporal", "beta", format(current_date, "%Y-%m-%d"))
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# PERMANOVA
sink(file.path(out_dir, "permanova_aitchison_paired_vaxEVER.txt"))
cat("PERMANOVA pareada (Aitchison) para vax_ever, estratificada por Patient_ID\n")
print(perma)
sink()

# NMDS plot
ggsave(filename = file.path(out_dir, "nmds_aitchison_paired_vaxEVER.pdf"),
       plot = beta_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(beta_plot)
```

#beta para no vacunados no covid
```{r}
# 0) Packages
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================
# 1) Base filtering: exclude COVID cases and (if present) pregnant
# ============================
phy <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)

preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy <- subset_samples(phy, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# ============================
# 2) Metadata base: never COVID+, visits 1-3, map vax_ever
# ============================
meta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)

meta <- meta %>% filter(COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No",
                        Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit")) %>%
  mutate(
    vax_ever = case_when(
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("Yes","YES","yes","Y") ~ "Yes",
      COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj %in% c("No","NO","no","N") ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)
    ),
    vax_ever = factor(vax_ever, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# ============================
# 3) Build never-vax pairs: First (No) vs Post (No = Second or, else, Third)
#    Rule: if patient has both 2 and 3 with No, pick Second. Only one comparison per patient.
# ============================
# IDs with First=No and at least one post=No (Second or Third)
wide_nv <- meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number, vax_ever) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = vax_ever)

ids_target <- wide_nv %>%
  filter(First_Visit == "No" &
           (Second_Visit == "No" | Third_Visit == "No")) %>%
  pull(Patient_ID) %>% unique()

# Baseline: First=No
first_no <- meta %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "First_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

# Post preference: Second=No if exists; else Third=No
second_no <- meta %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "Second_Visit", vax_ever == "No")

third_no <- meta %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_target,
         Visit_Number == "Third_Visit", vax_ever == "No",
         !(Patient_ID %in% second_no$Patient_ID))

post_no <- bind_rows(second_no, third_no)

# Combine and collapse visits to First_Visit vs Post_Visit
meta_pairs0 <- bind_rows(first_no, post_no) %>%
  arrange(Patient_ID, Visit_Number) %>%
  mutate(
    Visit_Number = case_when(
      Visit_Number %in% c("Second_Visit","Third_Visit") ~ "Post_Visit",
      TRUE ~ Visit_Number
    ),
    Visit_Number = factor(Visit_Number, levels = c("First_Visit","Post_Visit")),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months)
  )

# ============================
# 4) Filter covariates and re-ensure pairing (avoid unpaired samples)
# ============================
meta_pairs1 <- meta_pairs0 %>%
  filter(complete.cases(Visit_Number, Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months))

meta_pairs <- meta_pairs1 %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  filter(all(c("First_Visit","Post_Visit") %in% Visit_Number)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Safety checks: exactly two rows per patient, both "No" (never vaccinated)
stopifnot(all(table(meta_pairs$Patient_ID) == 2))
stopifnot(all(meta_pairs$vax_ever == "No"))

# ============================
# 5) Subset phyloseq, CLR, Aitchison distance
# ============================
phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_names(phy) %in% meta_pairs$SampleID, phy)
if (any(sample_sums(phy_sel) == 0)) {
  phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_sel) > 0, phy_sel)
}

phy_clr <- microbiome::transform(phy_sel, "clr", target = "otu_table")
dist_ait <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr, method = "euclidean")


# 1) Asegurar SampleID en ambas
meta_beta <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_clr)) %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID")

# 2) Quitar del lado izquierdo las columnas que también vendrán desde meta_pairs
dup_cols <- intersect(names(meta_beta),
                      c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months","vax_ever"))
meta_beta <- meta_beta %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::all_of(dup_cols))

# 3) Hacer el join aportando SOLO las columnas necesarias desde meta_pairs
meta_beta <- meta_beta %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_pairs %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months),
    by = "SampleID"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID),
    Visit_Number = factor(Visit_Number, levels = c("First_Visit","Post_Visit")),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months)
  )

# 4) Chequeo de alineación
stopifnot(all(sample_names(phy_clr) == meta_beta$SampleID))
# ============================
# 6) Paired PERMANOVA (strata = Patient_ID)
# ============================
set.seed(123)
perma <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist_ait ~ Visit_Number + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_beta$Patient_ID,
  by = "margin"
)
print(perma)

# Grab Visit_Number row safely
vn_row <- which(rownames(perma) == "Visit_Number")
R2_vn <- if (length(vn_row) == 1) perma$R2[vn_row] else NA_real_
p_vn  <- if (length(vn_row) == 1) perma$`Pr(>F)`[vn_row] else NA_real_

# ============================
# 7) NMDS plot (spaghetti by Patient_ID)
# ============================
set.seed(123)
nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(dist_ait, k = 2, trymax = 100,
                       autotransform = FALSE, wascores = FALSE, noshare = FALSE)
stress_val <- nmds$stress

nmds_pts <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
colnames(nmds_pts) <- c("NMDS1","NMDS2")
stopifnot(all(rownames(nmds_pts) == sample_names(phy_clr)))

plot_df <- cbind(nmds_pts, meta_beta)

beta_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, fill = Visit_Number)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "grey55", alpha = 0.75, linewidth = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = Visit_Number), type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set3", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS (Aitchison) — Never vaccinated: First vs Post (2/3)",
    subtitle = sprintf("Paired PERMANOVA: R2 = %.3f, p = %.4f | Stress = %.4f",
                       R2_vn, p_vn, stress_val),
    x = "NMDS1", y = "NMDS2", fill = "Visit", color = "Visit"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9))

# ============================
# 8) Save outputs
# ============================
out_dir <- file.path("results","temporal","beta_neverVax", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d"))
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

sink(file.path(out_dir, "permanova_aitchison_paired_First_vs_Post.txt"))
cat("Paired PERMANOVA (Aitchison) — Never vaccinated: First vs Post (2/3)\n\n")
print(perma)
sink()

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "nmds_aitchison_paired_First_vs_Post.pdf"),
       plot = beta_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

print(beta_plot)
```

#beta juntando no covid y no vacunados
```{r}
# ============================
# Beta diversity: Before vs After by PostVaccinated (mismo dataset/filtros que alfa)
# ============================

# Paquetes
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(microbiome)   # CLR
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

# ---------- 1) Filtros base (igual que alfa) ----------
phy <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)

preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy <- subset_samples(phy, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# Metadatos: nunca COVID+
data <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
data$SampleID <- rownames(data)
data <- subset(data, COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No")

# ---------- 2) Mismo emparejamiento que alfa (Before = First; After = Second si hay, si no Third) ----------
data_123 <- subset(data, Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit")) %>%
  mutate(
    vax_raw = tolower(as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)),
    vax_ever_row = case_when(
      vax_raw %in% c("yes","y") ~ "Yes",
      vax_raw %in% c("no","n")  ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    vax_ever_row = factor(vax_ever_row, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

wide_vis <- data_123 %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number) %>% distinct() %>%
  mutate(has_visit = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = has_visit, values_fill = FALSE)

eligible_ids <- wide_vis %>%
  filter(First_Visit, (Second_Visit | Third_Visit)) %>% pull(Patient_ID)

before_rows <- data_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "First_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("Before", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

after_second <- data_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "Second_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

ids_without_second <- setdiff(eligible_ids, unique(after_second$Patient_ID))

after_third <- data_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_without_second, Visit_Number == "Third_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(SampleID, Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Period, vax_ever_row,
         Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months, everything())

paired <- bind_rows(before_rows, after_second, after_third) %>%
  arrange(Patient_ID, Period) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months),
    Patient_ID = factor(Patient_ID)
  )

# PostVaccinated (copiar del After al Before)
paired <- paired %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  mutate(
    PostVaccinated = case_when(
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "No"  ~ "No",
      Period == "After" & is.na(vax_ever_row)   ~ NA_character_,
      Period == "Before"                        ~ NA_character_
    ),
    PostVaccinated = ifelse(Period == "Before",
                            PostVaccinated[Period == "After"],
                            PostVaccinated)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(PostVaccinated = factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes")))

cat("Before/After:\n"); print(table(paired$Period))
cat("After vaccinated status:\n"); print(table(paired$PostVaccinated[paired$Period=="After"], useNA="ifany"))

# ---------- 3) Filtrado estricto (mismas covariables que alfa) ----------
rows_ok <- paired %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(Sex), !is.na(antibiotics_last_2months),
         !is.na(PostVaccinated)) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>% ungroup()

if (nrow(rows_ok) < 10 || length(unique(rows_ok$Patient_ID)) < 5 ||
    length(unique(rows_ok$PostVaccinated)) < 2) {
  stop("Insuficiente data tras emparejar/filtrar para beta-diversity.")
}

# ---------- 4) Subset phyloseq a estas muestras y transformar CLR ----------
sample_keep <- rows_ok$SampleID
stopifnot(length(sample_keep) > 0)
phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_names(phy) %in% sample_keep, phy)
if (nsamples(phy_sel) == 0) stop("Cero muestras tras el prune_samples.")

# Quitar muestras con suma 0 si las hubiera
if (any(sample_sums(phy_sel) == 0)) phy_sel <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy_sel) > 0, phy_sel)

# CLR en tabla de OTUs
phy_clr <- microbiome::transform(phy_sel, "clr", target = "otu_table")

# ---------- 5) Metadata sincronizado para PERMANOVA/NMDS ----------
# --- construir meta_beta uniendo por Patient_ID + Visit_Number y trayendo SampleID correcto ---

# 5) Metadata sincronizado para PERMANOVA/NMDS (trae Period/PostVaccinated desde rows_ok)

# Punto de partida: metadatos originales
data <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
data$SampleID <- rownames(data)

# 1. Extrae solo las muestras presentes en phy_clr
meta_clr <- subset(data, SampleID %in% sample_names(phy_clr),
                   select = c(SampleID, Patient_ID, Visit_Number, Age, BMI, Sex, antibiotics_last_2months))

# 2. Llave única desde rows_ok
rows_key <- unique(rows_ok[, c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Period","PostVaccinated")])

# 3. Une con merge
meta_beta <- merge(meta_clr, rows_key, by = c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number"), all.x = TRUE)

# 4. Factores + filtro
meta_beta <- within(meta_beta, {
  Patient_ID <- factor(Patient_ID)
  Period <- factor(Period, levels = c("Before","After"))
  PostVaccinated <- factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes"))
})
meta_beta <- meta_beta[complete.cases(meta_beta[, c("Patient_ID","Period","PostVaccinated","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months")]), ]

# 5. Alinear orden
phy_clr   <- prune_samples(meta_beta$SampleID, phy_clr)
meta_beta <- meta_beta[match(sample_names(phy_clr), meta_beta$SampleID), ]


# Alinear orden
phy_clr <- prune_samples(meta_beta$SampleID, phy_clr)
meta_beta <- meta_beta[match(sample_names(phy_clr), meta_beta$SampleID), ]

cat("nsamples phy_sel:", nsamples(phy_sel), "\n")
print(table(meta_beta$Period, meta_beta$PostVaccinated, useNA="ifany"))
cat("n pacientes:", length(unique(meta_beta$Patient_ID)), "\n")

# ---------- 6) Distancia de Aitchison (Euclid en CLR) ----------
dist_ait <- phyloseq::distance(phy_clr, method = "euclidean")

# ---------- 6b) Chequeo de dispersión (recomendado para PERMANOVA) ----------
bd <- betadisper(as.dist(dist_ait), meta_beta$PostVaccinated)
bd_test <- anova(bd)


  
# ---------- 7) PERMANOVA pareada (efectos marginales) ----------
set.seed(123)
perma <- vegan::adonis2(
  dist_ait ~ Period * PostVaccinated + Age + BMI + Sex + antibiotics_last_2months,
  data = meta_beta,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_beta$Patient_ID,
  by = "margin"
)
print(perma); cat("\nHomogeneity of dispersion p =", signif(bd_test$`Pr(>F)`[1], 4), "\n")

# ---------- 8) NMDS (spaghetti) ----------
set.seed(123)
nmds <- vegan::metaMDS(dist_ait, k = 2, trymax = 100,
                       autotransform = FALSE, wascores = FALSE, noshare = FALSE)
stress_val <- nmds$stress

nmds_pts <- as.data.frame(vegan::scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
colnames(nmds_pts) <- c("NMDS1","NMDS2"); nmds_pts$SampleID <- rownames(nmds_pts)

plot_df <- nmds_pts %>%
  left_join(meta_beta[, c("SampleID","Patient_ID","Period","PostVaccinated")], by = "SampleID")

beta_plot <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Patient_ID), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(aes(color = PostVaccinated, shape = Period), size = 2.6) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(color = PostVaccinated), type = "t", level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", drop = FALSE) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS (Aitchison) — Before vs After by PostVaccinated",
    subtitle = paste0("PERMANOVA (paired): Period p=",
                      formatC(perma$`Pr(>F)`[rownames(perma)=="Period"], digits = 4, format = "f"),
                      "; Period:PostVaccinated p=",
                      formatC(perma$`Pr(>F)`[rownames(perma)=="Period:PostVaccinated"], digits = 4, format = "f"),
                      " | Dispersion p=",
                      formatC(bd_test$`Pr(>F)`[1], digits = 4, format = "f"),
                      " | Stress=", round(stress_val, 4)),
    color = "After is post-vaccine?", shape = "Period"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9))

print(beta_plot)

# ---------- 9) Distancia Before–After por paciente (boxplot por PostVaccinated) ----------
dm <- as.matrix(dist_ait)
meta_min <- meta_beta %>% dplyr::select(SampleID, Patient_ID, Period, PostVaccinated)

pairs <- meta_min %>% arrange(Patient_ID, Period) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>%
  summarise(
    s1 = first(SampleID), s2 = last(SampleID),
    PostVaccinated = first(PostVaccinated), .groups = "drop"
  )

pairs$BA_distance <- mapply(function(a,b) dm[a,b], pairs$s1, pairs$s2)

p_delta <- ggplot(pairs, aes(PostVaccinated, BA_distance, fill = PostVaccinated)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Within-subject Aitchison distance (After vs Before)",
       x = "After is post-vaccine?", y = "Aitchison distance (pair)") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")
print(p_delta)

# ---------- 10) Guardar ----------
current_date <- Sys.Date()
out_dir <- file.path("results", "temporal", "beta_before_after_by_postvax",
                     format(current_date, "%Y%m%d"))
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# PERMANOVA + dispersión
sink(file.path(out_dir, "PERMANOVA_aitchison_paired_PeriodXPostVax.txt"))
cat("PERMANOVA pareada (Aitchison) ~ Period * PostVaccinated + covariables | strata=Patient_ID\n\n")
print(perma)
cat("\nHomogeneity of dispersion (betadisper):\n"); print(bd_test)
sink()

# Figuras
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "NMDS_Aitchison_BeforeAfter_byPostVax.pdf"),
       beta_plot, width = 6.2, height = 5.4)
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "BA_Aitchison_distance_byPostVax.pdf"),
       p_delta, width = 4.6, height = 4.2)
```

#maaslin para no covid vacunados vs sí vacunados
```{r}
# ============================
# Maaslin2 con MISMO FILTRADO/DATASET que alfa/beta (sin left_join)
# ============================
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(Maaslin2)

# ---------- 0) Parámetros ----------
today <- Sys.Date()
out_root <- file.path("results", "maaslin2", format(today, "%Y-%m-%d"),
                      "From_No_to_yes_vax_before_after_by_postvax_same_filters")
perc_samples <- 0.20
abundance_threshold <- 15

# ---------- 1) Filtros base (igual que alfa/beta) ----------
phy0 <- subset_samples(
  PHYrar_alpha,
  is.na(covid_casos_control_analysis) | covid_casos_control_analysis != "Yes"
)
preg_var <- intersect(c("pregnant","Pregnant"), sample_variables(phy0))
if (length(preg_var) == 1) {
  phy0 <- subset_samples(phy0, is.na(get(preg_var)) | get(preg_var) != "Yes")
}

# Metadatos y normalización de vacunación
dat <- data.frame(sample_data(phy0))
dat$SampleID <- rownames(dat)
dat <- subset(dat, COVID_consensus_COVID19_ever == "Negative_No")

dat_123 <- subset(dat, Visit_Number %in% c("First_Visit","Second_Visit","Third_Visit")) %>%
  mutate(
    vax_raw = tolower(as.character(COVID19_vaccinaed_ever_adj)),
    vax_ever_row = case_when(
      vax_raw %in% c("yes","y") ~ "Yes",
      vax_raw %in% c("no","n")  ~ "No",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    vax_ever_row = factor(vax_ever_row, levels = c("No","Yes"))
  )

# ---------- 2) Pares Before/After exactamente como en alfa/beta ----------
wide_vis <- dat_123 %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Visit_Number) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(has_visit = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Visit_Number, values_from = has_visit, values_fill = FALSE)

eligible_ids <- wide_vis %>%
  filter(First_Visit, (Second_Visit | Third_Visit)) %>% pull(Patient_ID)

before_rows <- dat_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "First_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("Before", levels = c("Before","After")))

after_second <- dat_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% eligible_ids, Visit_Number == "Second_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After")))

ids_without_second <- setdiff(eligible_ids, unique(after_second$Patient_ID))
after_third <- dat_123 %>%
  filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_without_second, Visit_Number == "Third_Visit") %>%
  mutate(Period = factor("After", levels = c("Before","After")))

paired <- bind_rows(before_rows, after_second, after_third) %>%
  arrange(Patient_ID, Period) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    PostVaccinated = case_when(
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "Yes" ~ "Yes",
      Period == "After" & vax_ever_row == "No"  ~ "No",
      Period == "After" & is.na(vax_ever_row)   ~ NA_character_,
      Period == "Before"                        ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>%
  mutate(PostVaccinated = ifelse(Period == "Before",
                                 PostVaccinated[Period == "After"], PostVaccinated)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    PostVaccinated = factor(PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes")),
    Sex = factor(Sex),
    antibiotics_last_2months = factor(antibiotics_last_2months)
  )

# ---------- 2A) FILTRO ESTRICTO DE COVARIABLES ----------
rows_ok <- paired %>%
  filter(!is.na(Age), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(Sex),
         !is.na(antibiotics_last_2months), !is.na(PostVaccinated)) %>%
  group_by(Patient_ID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Period) == 2) %>% ungroup()

# ---------- 2B) ### CAMBIO: limitar a transiciones No -> Yes antes de mapear SampleID ----------
stopifnot("vax_ever_row" %in% names(rows_ok))  # aseguramos que existe

trans <- rows_ok %>%
  dplyr::select(Patient_ID, Period, vax_ever_row) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Period, values_from = vax_ever_row)

ids_no2yes <- trans %>%
  dplyr::filter(Before == "No", After == "Yes") %>%
  dplyr::pull(Patient_ID) %>% unique()

rows_ok <- rows_ok %>% dplyr::filter(Patient_ID %in% ids_no2yes)

# Chequeos rápidos (esperado: 17 pacientes -> 34 filas, 17 Before / 17 After)
cat("Pacientes No→Yes:", length(unique(rows_ok$Patient_ID)), "\n")
cat("Filas en rows_ok:", nrow(rows_ok), "\n")
print(table(rows_ok$Period))

# ---------- 2C) ### CAMBIO: mapeo SIN joins a SampleID SOLO de No→Yes ----------
dat_key <- dat[, c("SampleID","Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months")]
dat_key$Patient_ID   <- trimws(as.character(dat_key$Patient_ID))
dat_key$Visit_Number <- trimws(as.character(dat_key$Visit_Number))
dat_key$key <- paste(dat_key$Patient_ID, dat_key$Visit_Number, sep="||")

rows_key <- rows_ok[, c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Period","PostVaccinated")]
rows_key$Patient_ID   <- trimws(as.character(rows_key$Patient_ID))
rows_key$Visit_Number <- trimws(as.character(rows_key$Visit_Number))
rows_key$key <- paste(rows_key$Patient_ID, rows_key$Visit_Number, sep="||")

idx <- match(rows_key$key, dat_key$key)
stopifnot(sum(is.na(idx)) == 0)
rows_key$SampleID <- dat_key$SampleID[idx]

sample_keep <- unique(rows_key$SampleID)
cat("n sample_keep (debería ser 34 si hay 17 pares):", length(sample_keep), "\n")
stopifnot(length(sample_keep) == 2*length(unique(rows_ok$Patient_ID)))

# ---------- 3) Podar phyloseq y construir metadata final (sólo con merge base R) ----------
phy <- prune_samples(sample_names(phy0) %in% sample_keep, phy0)
if (any(sample_sums(phy) == 0)) phy <- prune_samples(sample_sums(phy) > 0, phy)

# (a) metadata del phy ya podado
meta_final <- data.frame(sample_data(phy))
meta_final$SampleID <- rownames(meta_final)

# limpiamos posibles duplicados de columnas que añadiremos
drop_cols <- intersect(
  names(meta_final),
  c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months","Period","PostVaccinated")
)
if (length(drop_cols) > 0) meta_final[drop_cols] <- NULL

# (b) covariables por SampleID
meta_final <- merge(
  meta_final,
  dat_key[, c("SampleID","Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months")],
  by = "SampleID", all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)

# (c) Period/PostVaccinated por (Patient_ID, Visit_Number)
rows_dist <- unique(rows_key[, c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number","Period","PostVaccinated")])
meta_final <- merge(
  meta_final,
  rows_dist,
  by = c("Patient_ID","Visit_Number"),
  all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)

# Tipos y casos completos
meta_final$Patient_ID <- factor(meta_final$Patient_ID)
meta_final$Period <- factor(meta_final$Period, levels = c("Before","After"))
meta_final$PostVaccinated <- factor(meta_final$PostVaccinated, levels = c("No","Yes"))
meta_final$Sex <- factor(meta_final$Sex)
meta_final$antibiotics_last_2months <- factor(meta_final$antibiotics_last_2months)

keep_idx <- complete.cases(meta_final[, c("Patient_ID","Period","PostVaccinated","Age","BMI","Sex","antibiotics_last_2months")])
meta_final <- meta_final[keep_idx, ]

# Sincroniza phy al orden de meta_final
phy <- prune_samples(meta_final$SampleID, phy)
meta_final <- meta_final[match(sample_names(phy), meta_final$SampleID), ]
stopifnot(all(meta_final$SampleID == sample_names(phy)))

# (opcionales) checks
cat("nsamples(phy) =", nsamples(phy), "\n")
print(table(meta_final$Period, meta_final$PostVaccinated, useNA="ifany"))

# ============================
# 4) Maaslin2 a NIVEL ASV
# ============================
# Normaliza a % para decidir abundancia (Maaslin2 normaliza TSS él mismo)
phy_prop <- transform_sample_counts(
  phy,
  function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x/sum(x)*100
)

# Filtro de PREVALENCIA (evitamos filter_taxa por S4)
mat <- as(otu_table(phy_prop), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_prop)) mat <- t(mat)
prev_counts <- rowSums(mat > 0)
keep_prev   <- taxa_names(phy_prop)[prev_counts > perc_samples * ncol(mat)]
phy_prev <- prune_taxa(keep_prev, phy_prop)

# Filtro de ABUNDANCIA (sobre % agregados)
keep_abund <- taxa_names(phy_prev)[taxa_sums(phy_prev) > abundance_threshold]
phy_filt_asv <- prune_taxa(keep_abund, phy_prev)

cat("ASVs tras filtros — prevalencia:", length(keep_prev),
    " | abundancia:", length(keep_abund), "\n")
stopifnot(ntaxa(phy_filt_asv) > 0)

# Nombres únicos (y opcionalmente concatenar especie)
taxa_names(phy_filt_asv) <- make.unique(taxa_names(phy_filt_asv))
tax_df_asv <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_filt_asv))
new_names <- if ("Species" %in% colnames(tax_df_asv)) {
  ifelse(!is.na(tax_df_asv$Species) & nzchar(tax_df_asv$Species),
         paste0(tax_df_asv$Species, "|", rownames(tax_df_asv)),
         rownames(tax_df_asv))
} else rownames(tax_df_asv)
taxa_names(phy_filt_asv) <- new_names
rownames(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)) <- new_names

# Matrices para Maaslin2
otu_asv  <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_filt_asv)))
meta_asv <- meta_final[match(rownames(otu_asv), meta_final$SampleID), ]
rownames(meta_asv) <- meta_asv$SampleID

dir.create(file.path(out_root, "ASV"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
fit_asv <- Maaslin2(
  input_data      = otu_asv,
  input_metadata  = meta_asv,
  output          = file.path(out_root, "ASV"),
  fixed_effects   = c("Period", "Age", "BMI", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
  random_effects  = c("Patient_ID"),
  normalization   = "TSS",
  transform       = "LOG",
  analysis_method = "LM",
  correction      = "BH",
  standardize     = TRUE,
  max_significance= 0.25,
  min_abundance   = 0,
  min_prevalence  = 0
)

# ============================
# 5) Maaslin2 por NIVELES TAXONÓMICOS
# ============================
tax_levels <- c("Species","Genus","Family","Class","Order","Phylum")

tx <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
if ("Species" %in% colnames(tx)) {
  tx$Species <- ifelse(grepl("_s__Unclassified$", tx$Species),
                       paste0(tx$Species, "_", taxa_names(phy)), tx$Species)
  tax_table(phy) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tx))
}

for (lvl in tax_levels) {
  message("Procesando ", lvl)
  phy_lvl <- tax_glom(phy, taxrank = lvl)
  taxa_names(phy_lvl) <- make.unique(tax_table(phy_lvl)[, lvl])

  phy_lvl_prop <- transform_sample_counts(phy_lvl, function(x) if (sum(x)==0) x else x/sum(x))
  keep_taxa <- taxa_names(phy_lvl_prop)[colSums(as(otu_table(phy_lvl_prop), "matrix") > 0) >= (perc_samples * nsamples(phy_lvl_prop))]
  phy_lvl <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, phy_lvl)

  otu_lvl <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_lvl)))
  meta_lvl <- meta_final[match(rownames(otu_lvl), meta_final$SampleID), ]
  rownames(meta_lvl) <- meta_lvl$SampleID

  out_dir <- file.path(out_root, paste0(lvl))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = otu_lvl,
    input_metadata  = meta_lvl,
    output          = out_dir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Period", "Age", "BMI", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
    random_effects  = c("Patient_ID"),
    normalization   = "TSS",
    transform       = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction      = "BH",
    standardize     = TRUE,
    max_significance= 0.25,
    min_abundance   = 0,
    min_prevalence  = 0
  )
}

# ---------- Checks finales ----------
cat("n muestras finales:", nsamples(phy), "\n")
print(table(meta_final$Period, meta_final$PostVaccinated, useNA = "ifany"))

```

```{r}
  analysis_method = "LM",
  correction      = "BH",
  standardize     = TRUE,
  max_significance= 0.25,
  min_abundance   = 0,
  min_prevalence  = 0
)

# ============================
# 5) Maaslin2 por NIVELES TAXONÓMICOS
# ============================
tax_levels <- c("Species","Genus","Family","Class","Order","Phylum")

tx <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy))
if ("Species" %in% colnames(tx)) {
  tx$Species <- ifelse(grepl("_s__Unclassified$", tx$Species),
                       paste0(tx$Species, "_", taxa_names(phy)), tx$Species)
  tax_table(phy) <- tax_table(as.matrix(tx))
}

for (lvl in tax_levels) {
  message("Procesando ", lvl)
  phy_lvl <- tax_glom(phy, taxrank = lvl)
  taxa_names(phy_lvl) <- make.unique(tax_table(phy_lvl)[, lvl])

  phy_lvl_prop <- transform_sample_counts(phy_lvl, function(x) if (sum(x)==0) x else x/sum(x))
  keep_taxa <- taxa_names(phy_lvl_prop)[colSums(as(otu_table(phy_lvl_prop), "matrix") > 0) >= (perc_samples * nsamples(phy_lvl_prop))]
  phy_lvl <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, phy_lvl)

  otu_lvl <- as.data.frame(t(otu_table(phy_lvl)))
  meta_lvl <- meta_final[match(rownames(otu_lvl), meta_final$SampleID), ]
  rownames(meta_lvl) <- meta_lvl$SampleID

  out_dir <- file.path(out_root, paste0(lvl))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  Maaslin2(
    input_data      = otu_lvl,
    input_metadata  = meta_lvl,
    output          = out_dir,
    fixed_effects   = c("Period", "Age", "BMI", "Sex", "antibiotics_last_2months"),
    random_effects  = c("Patient_ID"),
    normalization   = "TSS",
    transform       = "LOG",
    analysis_method = "LM",
    correction      = "BH",
    standardize     = TRUE,
    max_significance= 0.25,
    min_abundance   = 0,
    min_prevalence  = 0
  )
}

# ---------- Checks finales ----------
cat("n muestras finales:", nsamples(phy), "\n")
print(table(meta_final$Period, meta_final$PostVaccinated, useNA = "ifany"))

```

```{r}
  "COV-T2-577","COV-T2-586","COV-T2-587","COV-T2-588","COV-T2-589","COV-T2-593",

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

## Subconjunto de muestras usando la columna 'id'
phy_sub <- subset_samples(phy, id %in% sample_ids)

# (Opcional) quitar taxa que quedaron con suma 0 después del subset
phy_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_sub) > 0, phy_sub)

# A nivel de Género
phy_gen <- tax_glom(phy_sub, taxrank = "Genus")

# --- 1) Abundancia relativa (%)
phy_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  phy_gen,
  function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x / sum(x) * 100
)

# --- Opción A: renombrar taxa_names a la columna Genus (asegurando unicidad)
gn <- as.character(tax_table(phy_rel)[, "Genus"])
taxa_names(phy_rel) <- make.unique(gn)  # agrega .1, .2 si hay duplicados

# --- 2) Metadata y colapso de visitas (forzar data.frame/tibble) ---
data2 <- as(sample_data(phy_rel), "data.frame")              # <- coerción S4 -> data.frame
data2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(data2, var = "SampleID") # mantener SampleID
# Asegura el orden de niveles
data2$Visit_Number <- factor(data2$Visit_Number,
                             levels = c("First_Visit", "Second_Visit", "Third_Visit"))
# Colapsa a Before/After
data2$Period2 <- ifelse(data2$Visit_Number == "First_Visit", "Before", "After")
data2$Period2 <- factor(data2$Period2, levels = c("Before", "After"))

# --- 3) Extrae abundancias de los géneros de interés (robusto a duplicados) ---
genus_list <- c("g__Peptococcus", "g__Catonella")

# matriz con taxa en filas
mat <- as(otu_table(phy_rel), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_rel)) mat <- t(mat)

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_rel), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

present <- intersect(genus_list, unique(as.character(tax$Genus)))
if (length(present) == 0) stop("Ninguno de los géneros está en phy_rel.")

# sumar todas las filas que correspondan al mismo Genus
for (g in present) {
  idx <- which(tax$Genus == g)
  data2[[g]] <- if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else colSums(mat[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

# --- 4) LARGO y boxplot (facet por género) + líneas por PatientID ---
# Ensure PatientID column: use existing if present; otherwise derive from SampleID suffix
if (!"PatientID" %in% names(data2)) {
  data2$PatientID <- sub("^.*-", "", data2$SampleID)
}

data_long <- data2 |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = tidyselect::any_of(present),
                      names_to = "Genus", values_to = "Abundance") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Abundance))

# Keep only patients that have both Before and After within each Genus for lines
pairs_for_lines <- data_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID, Genus) |>
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Period2) == 2) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Create output dir (if not exists)
outdir <- file.path("results", "temporal", "maaslin2")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

set.seed(123) # reproducible jitter
p <- ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Period2, y = Abundance)) +
  # boxplot with default palette via fill=Period2
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Period2), outlier.shape = NA) +
  # spaghetti lines by patient, neutral color so points carry the palette
  geom_line(data = pairs_for_lines,
            aes(group = interaction(PatientID, Genus)),
            alpha = 0.4) +
  # points colored by Period2 using default discrete palette
  geom_point(             position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0),
             size = 1.3, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Genus, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Genus abundance Before vs After",
       x = "", y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = "Period"),
         color = guide_legend(title = "Period"))

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"),
                                      "_genus_abundance_before_after_noCovid_noVaxNoVax.pdf")),
  plot = p, width = 4.5, height = 4.5
)
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

## Subconjunto de muestras usando la columna 'id'
phy_sub <- subset_samples(phy, id %in% sample_ids)

# (Opcional) quitar taxa que quedaron con suma 0 después del subset
phy_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(phy_sub) > 0, phy_sub)

# A nivel de Género
phy_gen <- tax_glom(phy_sub, taxrank = "Genus")

# --- 1) Abundancia relativa (%)
phy_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  phy_gen,
  function(x) if (sum(x) == 0) x else x / sum(x) * 100
)

# --- Opción A: renombrar taxa_names a la columna Genus (asegurando unicidad)
gn <- as.character(tax_table(phy_rel)[, "Genus"])
taxa_names(phy_rel) <- make.unique(gn)  # agrega .1, .2 si hay duplicados

# --- 2) Metadata y colapso de visitas (forzar data.frame/tibble) ---
data2 <- as(sample_data(phy_rel), "data.frame")              # <- coerción S4 -> data.frame
data2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(data2, var = "SampleID") # mantener SampleID
# Asegura el orden de niveles
data2$Visit_Number <- factor(data2$Visit_Number,
                             levels = c("First_Visit", "Second_Visit", "Third_Visit"))
# Colapsa a Before/After
data2$Period2 <- ifelse(data2$Visit_Number == "First_Visit", "Before", "After")
data2$Period2 <- factor(data2$Period2, levels = c("Before", "After"))

# --- 3) Extrae abundancias de los géneros de interés (robusto a duplicados) ---
genus_list <- c("g__Treponema",
"g__Campylobacter","g__Haemophilus","g__Oribacterium","g__Selenomonas","g__Peptococcus")

# matriz con taxa en filas
mat <- as(otu_table(phy_rel), "matrix")
if (!taxa_are_rows(phy_rel)) mat <- t(mat)

tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_rel), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

present <- intersect(genus_list, unique(as.character(tax$Genus)))
if (length(present) == 0) stop("Ninguno de los géneros está en phy_rel.")

# sumar todas las filas que correspondan al mismo Genus
for (g in present) {
  idx <- which(tax$Genus == g)
  data2[[g]] <- if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else colSums(mat[idx, , drop = FALSE])
}
```

#test for variance homogeneity between first and third visit shannon: equivalentele a levene test pero para muestars pareadas

```{r}

library(PairedData)

# convertir los datos a formato pareado
wide <- reshape(data2[, c("Patient_ID", "Visit_Number", "shannon_rar_asv")],
                timevar = "Visit_Number", idvar = "Patient_ID", direction = "wide")

# Test de Pitman-Morgan
with(wide, var.test(shannon_rar_asv.First_Visit, shannon_rar_asv.Third_Visit, paired = TRUE))

#para obs_rar_asv
wide1 <- reshape(data2[, c("Patient_ID", "Visit_Number", "obs_rar_asv")],
                timevar = "Visit_Number", idvar = "Patient_ID", direction = "wide")
with(wide1, var.test(obs_rar_asv.First_Visit, obs_rar_asv.Third_Visit, paired = TRUE))

#guadar en cvs
#shannon
capture.output(with(wide, var.test(shannon_rar_asv.First_Visit, shannon_rar_asv.Third_Visit, paired = TRUE)), 
               file = paste0("results/temporal/alpha/", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), "_Pitman-Morgan_test_shannon_2timepoints_noCovid.csv"))

#save for observed
capture.output(with(wide1, var.test(obs_rar_asv.First_Visit, obs_rar_asv.Third_Visit, paired = TRUE)), 
               file = paste0("results/temporal/alpha/", format(Sys.Date(), "%Y%m%d"), "_Pitman-Morgan_test_observed_2timepoints_noCovid.csv"))
```

```{r}
sample_data(PHYrar_alpha) <- sd

## 5) Quick diagnostics
table(sd$sarscov2_pos_vs_neg_crosssectional)
table(sd$sarscov2_pos_vs_neg_longitudinal)
table(sd$vaccination_influence_longitudinal)





## 2) Create a single flag: keep sample if any category == "Yes"
sd <- as.data.frame(sample_data(PHYrar_alpha))

sd$keep_for_analysis <- ifelse(
  sd$sarscov2_pos_vs_neg_crosssectional == "Yes" |
    sd$sarscov2_pos_vs_neg_longitudinal == "Yes" |
    sd$vaccination_influence_longitudinal == "Yes",
  TRUE, FALSE
)

print(table(sd$keep_for_analysis))

## 🚨 FALTA ESTO: escribir la columna en sample_data del phyloseq
sample_data(PHYrar_alpha)$keep_for_analysis <- sd$keep_for_analysis

## 4) Ahora sí: subset usando la columna dentro del objeto phyloseq
phy_filtered <- subset_samples(PHYrar_alpha, keep_for_analysis == TRUE)

#save metadata


# Si quieres, reemplazar el objeto original:
 PHYrar_alpha_to_paper <- phy_filtered
 sample_data(PHYrar_alpha_to_paper)$keep_for_analysis <- NULL  # opcional borrar la columna
saveRDS(PHYrar_alpha_to_paper, file="/Users/danielavargasrobles/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-danielavargasrobles@gmail.com/My Drive/Filipa_Daniela_2021 -present/Proyectos/ORAL_COVID/phy_objects/PHYrar_alpha_to_paper.rds")
```
